enum ucp_ep_close_mode {
    UCP_EP_CLOSE_MODE_FORCE         = 0, /**< @ref ucp_ep_close_nb releases
                                              the endpoint without any
                                              confirmation from the peer. All
                                              outstanding requests will be
                                              completed with
                                              @ref UCS_ERR_CANCELED error.
                                              @note This mode may cause
                                              transport level errors on remote
                                              side, so it requires set
                                              @ref UCP_ERR_HANDLING_MODE_PEER
                                              for all endpoints created on
                                              both (local and remote) sides to
                                              avoid undefined behavior. */
    UCP_EP_CLOSE_MODE_FLUSH         = 1  /**< @ref ucp_ep_close_nb schedules
                                              flushes on all outstanding
                                              operations. */
};

functions.name: ucp_lib_query
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_lib_query(ucp_lib_attr_t *attr);
functions.description: Fetches UCP library attributes into the provided attr structure. Caller sets field_mask to indicate which fields to fill.
requirements: attr must be a valid, writable pointer
attr->field_mask must include bits from ucp_lib_attr_field for fields to be returned

functions.name: ucp_config_read
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_config_read(const char *env_prefix, const char *filename, ucp_config_t **config_p);
functions.description: Reads UCP configuration from the environment and optionally from a file and returns an allocated configuration descriptor.
requirements: config_p must be a valid, writable pointer
If env_prefix is non-NULL, variables are prefixed with <env_prefix>_UCX_, otherwise UCX_
If filename is non-NULL and does not exist, it is ignored without error

functions.name: ucp_config_release
functions.signature: void ucp_config_release(ucp_config_t *config);
functions.description: Releases a configuration descriptor previously returned by ucp_config_read.
requirements: config must be a descriptor allocated by ucp_config_read and not already released

functions.name: ucp_config_modify
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_config_modify(ucp_config_t *config, const char *name, const char *value);
functions.description: Modifies a single configuration variable in a configuration descriptor.
requirements: config must be a valid descriptor obtained from ucp_config_read
name must be a valid configuration key
value must be a string acceptable for the given key

functions.name: ucp_config_print
functions.signature: void ucp_config_print(const ucp_config_t *config, FILE *stream, const char *title, ucs_config_print_flags_t print_flags);
functions.description: Prints the given configuration descriptor to a stream with an optional title and print flags.
requirements: config must be a valid descriptor
stream must be a valid FILE* opened for writing

functions.name: ucp_get_version
functions.signature: void ucp_get_version(unsigned *major_version, unsigned *minor_version, unsigned *release_number);
functions.description: Retrieves the UCP library version components.
requirements: major_version, minor_version, and release_number must be valid writable pointers

functions.name: ucp_get_version_string
functions.signature: const char *ucp_get_version_string(void);
functions.description: Returns a string of the form "major.minor.release" describing UCP version.
requirements: Returned pointer remains valid for the lifetime of the process; do not modify or free

functions.name: ucp_init
functions.signature: static inline ucs_status_t ucp_init(const ucp_params_t *params, const ucp_config_t *config, ucp_context_h *context_p);
functions.description: Initializes a UCP application context using params and config, performing version compatibility checks. This must be called before any other UCP call.
requirements: params must point to a properly initialized ucp_params_t; required fields (e.g., features) must be indicated in field_mask
config must be a configuration descriptor from ucp_config_read
context_p must be a valid writable pointer
Must be called before other UCP routines; after ucp_cleanup no UCP calls are allowed until re-initialized

functions.name: ucp_cleanup
functions.signature: void ucp_cleanup(ucp_context_h context_p);
functions.description: Finalizes and releases resources associated with a UCP application context.
requirements: context_p must be a valid UCP context returned by ucp_init
After this call, no UCP routine may be called until reinitialized

functions.name: ucp_context_query
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_context_query(ucp_context_h context_p, ucp_context_attr_t *attr);
functions.description: Queries attributes of a UCP context and fills the provided attr based on its field_mask.
requirements: context_p must be a valid UCP context
attr must be a valid, writable pointer with field_mask specifying requested fields

functions.name: ucp_rkey_compare
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_rkey_compare(ucp_worker_h worker, ucp_rkey_h rkey1, ucp_rkey_h rkey2, const ucp_rkey_compare_params_t *params, int *result);
functions.description: Compares two remote keys that belong to the same worker and returns an ordering relation via result.
requirements: worker must be the worker both rkeys belong to
rkey1 and rkey2 must be valid rkeys associated with worker
params->field_mask must currently be zero
result must be a valid writable pointer

functions.name: ucp_context_print_info
functions.signature: void ucp_context_print_info(const ucp_context_h context, FILE *stream);
functions.description: Prints detailed information about a context’s configuration and resources to the given stream.
requirements: context must be a valid UCP context
stream must be a valid FILE* opened for writing

functions.name: ucp_worker_create
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_worker_create(ucp_context_h context, const ucp_worker_params_t *params, ucp_worker_h *worker_p);
functions.description: Creates a worker associated with the given context according to params.
requirements: context must be a valid initialized UCP context
params must be a valid pointer; any fields used must be indicated in params->field_mask
worker_p must be a valid writable pointer

functions.name: ucp_worker_destroy
functions.signature: void ucp_worker_destroy(ucp_worker_h worker);
functions.description: Destroys a worker and releases associated resources.
requirements: worker must be a valid worker created by ucp_worker_create
After destroy, the handle must not be used with any UCP routine

functions.name: ucp_worker_query
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_worker_query(ucp_worker_h worker, ucp_worker_attr_t *attr);
functions.description: Queries attributes of a worker and fills the provided attr according to its field_mask.
requirements: worker must be valid
attr must be valid and writable; attr->field_mask specifies requested fields
If UCP_WORKER_ATTR_FIELD_ADDRESS is requested, the returned address must be released with ucp_worker_release_address

functions.name: ucp_worker_print_info
functions.signature: void ucp_worker_print_info(ucp_worker_h worker, FILE *stream);
functions.description: Prints detailed information about worker protocols and transports.
requirements: worker must be valid
stream must be writable

functions.name: ucp_worker_release_address
functions.signature: void ucp_worker_release_address(ucp_worker_h worker, ucp_address_t *address);
functions.description: Releases a worker address obtained via ucp_worker_query.
requirements: address must have been allocated by ucp_worker_query for the given worker
Do not use address after release

functions.name: ucp_worker_address_query
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_worker_address_query(ucp_address_t *address, ucp_worker_address_attr_t *attr);
functions.description: Queries attributes of a worker address (local or remote) and fills attr based on field_mask.
requirements: address must be a valid worker address
attr must be valid and writable with field_mask indicating requested fields

functions.name: ucp_worker_progress
functions.signature: unsigned ucp_worker_progress(ucp_worker_h worker);
functions.description: Explicitly progresses communication operations on the worker. Returns non-zero if any progress occurred.
requirements: worker must be valid
Caller should not rely on non-blocking operations to make progress unless calling this or other progress paths

functions.name: ucp_stream_worker_poll
functions.signature: ssize_t ucp_stream_worker_poll(ucp_worker_h worker, ucp_stream_poll_ep_t *poll_eps, size_t max_eps, unsigned flags);
functions.description: Polls a worker for endpoints ready to consume stream data and fills up to max_eps entries in poll_eps.
requirements: worker must be valid
poll_eps must point to an array of at least max_eps entries and be writable
flags is reserved and should be 0

functions.name: ucp_worker_get_efd
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_worker_get_efd(ucp_worker_h worker, int *fd);
functions.description: Obtains a per-worker event file descriptor for wakeup notifications.
requirements: worker must be valid and created with wakeup-capable transports (UCP_FEATURE_WAKEUP requested at init) for effective use
fd must be a valid writable pointer
If an external event fd was provided in worker params, calling this may result in an error

functions.name: ucp_worker_wait
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_worker_wait(ucp_worker_h worker);
functions.description: Blocks until an event happens for the worker as part of the wake-up mechanism.
requirements: worker must be valid
Caller should drain existing events first by calling ucp_worker_progress until it returns 0
UCP_FEATURE_WAKEUP should be enabled for proper transport selection

functions.name: ucp_worker_wait_mem
functions.signature: void ucp_worker_wait_mem(ucp_worker_h worker, void *address);
functions.description: Blocks until either worker events occur or the specified local memory address is updated, enabling energy-efficient waiting loops.
requirements: worker must be valid
address must be a valid local memory address
Caller should drain events before waiting (use ucp_worker_progress until 0)

functions.name: ucp_worker_arm
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_worker_arm(ucp_worker_h worker);
functions.description: Arms a worker for the next wakeup event; typically called before polling the worker’s event fd.
requirements: worker must be valid
Must be re-armed after being signaled
If UCS_ERR_BUSY is returned, caller should progress the worker and retry
UCP_FEATURE_WAKEUP should be enabled for intended use

functions.name: ucp_worker_signal
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_worker_signal(ucp_worker_h worker);
functions.description: Signals an event on the worker to wake waiters on ucp_worker_wait or the worker’s event fd.
requirements: worker must be valid
Safe to call from any thread

functions.name: ucp_listener_create
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_listener_create(ucp_worker_h worker, const ucp_listener_params_t *params, ucp_listener_h *listener_p);
functions.description: Creates a listener bound to a local address to accept incoming client/server connections and optionally invoke user callbacks.
requirements: worker must be valid
params must be valid and its field_mask must declare set fields
UCP_LISTENER_PARAM_FIELD_SOCK_ADDR is mandatory
At least one of accept_handler or conn_handler should be provided to handle incoming connections
listener_p must be writable

functions.name: ucp_listener_destroy
functions.signature: void ucp_listener_destroy(ucp_listener_h listener);
functions.description: Stops accepting connections and destroys a listener.
requirements: listener must be a valid listener created by ucp_listener_create

functions.name: ucp_listener_query
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_listener_query(ucp_listener_h listener, ucp_listener_attr_t *attr);
functions.description: Queries attributes of a listener and fills attr based on field_mask.
requirements: listener must be valid
attr must be valid and writable with field_mask indicating requested fields

functions.name: ucp_conn_request_query
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_conn_request_query(ucp_conn_request_h conn_request, ucp_conn_request_attr_t *attr);
functions.description: Queries attributes of a connection request received on the server side and fills attr based on field_mask.
requirements: conn_request must be valid
attr must be valid and writable with field_mask indicating requested fields

functions.name: ucp_request_query
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_request_query(void *request, ucp_request_attr_t *attr);
functions.description: Queries attributes of a non-blocking request, such as status, mem_type, or a debug info string.
requirements: request must be a valid UCP request handle
attr must be valid and writable; attr->field_mask must specify requested fields
If INFO_STRING is requested, debug_string must point to a buffer of size debug_string_size

functions.name: ucp_ep_create
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_ep_create(ucp_worker_h worker, const ucp_ep_params_t *params, ucp_ep_h *ep_p);
functions.description: Creates and connects an endpoint on a worker to a remote peer using a worker address, socket address, or a connection request.
requirements: worker must be valid
params must be valid; one of: remote address, sockaddr, or conn_request must be provided via params->field_mask
params->flags may include UCP_EP_PARAMS_FLAGS_NO_LOOPBACK to avoid self-connection
ep_p must be a valid writable pointer

functions.name: ucp_ep_close_nbx
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_ep_close_nbx(ucp_ep_h ep, const ucp_request_param_t *param);
functions.description: Initiates non-blocking endpoint closure with behavior controlled by ucp_ep_close_flags via param->flags. May complete immediately, return a request, or fail.
requirements: ep must be a valid endpoint
param must be a valid pointer; operation-specific flags come from ucp_ep_close_flags_t in param->flags
UCP_EP_CLOSE_FLAG_FORCE forces immediate completion and requires peer error handling mode on both sides; incompatible with UCP_OP_ATTR_FLAG_NO_IMM_CMPL

functions.name: ucp_listener_reject
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_listener_reject(ucp_listener_h listener, ucp_conn_request_h conn_request);
functions.description: Rejects an incoming connection request and frees its resources; the remote err_handler (if set) is called with UCS_ERR_REJECTED.
requirements: listener must be a valid listener
conn_request must be a valid pending connection request for that listener

functions.name: ucp_ep_print_info
functions.signature: void ucp_ep_print_info(ucp_ep_h ep, FILE *stream);
functions.description: Prints endpoint configuration details such as transports and thresholds.
requirements: ep must be valid
stream must be writable

functions.name: ucp_ep_flush_nbx
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_ep_flush_nbx(ucp_ep_h ep, const ucp_request_param_t *param);
functions.description: Non-blocking flush of outstanding AMO and RMA operations on an endpoint; ensures completion at both origin and target for prior operations.
requirements: ep must be valid
param must be valid (may have op_attr_mask/callback)
Caller must manage returned request: poll with ucp_worker_progress and free with ucp_request_free if non-NULL and not error

functions.name: ucp_ep_evaluate_perf
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_ep_evaluate_perf(ucp_ep_h ep, const ucp_ep_evaluate_perf_param_t *param, ucp_ep_evaluate_perf_attr_t *attr);
functions.description: Estimates performance characteristics (e.g., estimated send time) for an endpoint given a message size.
requirements: ep must be valid
param must be valid and include UCP_EP_PERF_PARAM_FIELD_MESSAGE_SIZE in field_mask; message_size must be set
attr must be valid and writable; set attr->field_mask to include UCP_EP_PERF_ATTR_FIELD_ESTIMATED_TIME to retrieve it

functions.name: ucp_mem_map
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_mem_map(ucp_context_h context, const ucp_mem_map_params_t *params, ucp_mem_h *memh_p);
functions.description: Maps (registers) or allocates and maps memory with the given context for zero-copy operations, based on params flags and fields.
requirements: context must be a valid UCP context
params must be valid; UCP_MEM_MAP_PARAM_FIELD_LENGTH is mandatory and length > 0 expected
If ADDRESS is not set, treat as NULL and memory may be allocated
FLAGS/PROT/MEMORY_TYPE/EXPORTED_MEMH_BUFFER usage must match documented matrix and semantics; certain combinations are errors
memh_p must be a valid writable pointer

functions.name: ucp_mem_unmap
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_mem_unmap(ucp_context_h context, ucp_mem_h memh);
functions.description: Unmaps a memory segment previously mapped by ucp_mem_map and invalidates associated handles/keys.
requirements: context must be the same context used to map
memh must be a valid memory handle from ucp_mem_map
After unmap, memh and any rkeys derived become invalid

functions.name: ucp_mem_query
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_mem_query(const ucp_mem_h memh, ucp_mem_attr_t *attr);
functions.description: Returns attributes (address, length, etc.) of a mapped memory handle.
requirements: memh must be valid
attr must be valid and writable; its field mask must indicate requested attributes (per ucp_mem_attr_t)

functions.name: ucp_mem_print_info
functions.signature: void ucp_mem_print_info(const char *mem_spec, ucp_context_h context, FILE *stream);
functions.description: Maps memory described by mem_spec and prints information about the created memory handle.
requirements: mem_spec format: "<size>[,<type>]" (e.g., "32768", "1m,cuda")
context must be valid
stream must be writable

functions.name: ucp_mem_advise
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_mem_advise(ucp_context_h context, ucp_mem_h memh, ucp_mem_advise_params_t *params);
functions.description: Provides advice about how UCP should handle a memory range belonging to a mapped memory handle.
requirements: context must be valid
memh must be valid
params must be valid with field_mask including ADDRESS, LENGTH, and ADVICE; address/length must be within memh

functions.name: ucp_memh_pack
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_memh_pack(ucp_mem_h memh, const ucp_memh_pack_params_t *params, void **buffer_p, size_t *buffer_size_p);
functions.description: Allocates and packs a memory handle into a portable buffer for peers (e.g., to create an RKEY), optionally with export semantics.
requirements: memh must be valid
params must be valid; set field_mask to include FLAGS if flags are used
buffer_p and buffer_size_p must be valid writable pointers
The returned buffer must be released by ucp_memh_buffer_release

functions.name: ucp_memh_buffer_release
functions.signature: void ucp_memh_buffer_release(void *buffer, const ucp_memh_buffer_release_params_t *params);
functions.description: Releases a buffer allocated by ucp_memh_pack.
requirements: buffer must have been allocated by ucp_memh_pack
params must be valid and have required field_mask (all fields mandatory)
Undefined behavior if buffer did not originate from ucp_memh_pack

functions.name: ucp_ep_rkey_unpack
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_ep_rkey_unpack(ucp_ep_h ep, const void *rkey_buffer, ucp_rkey_h *rkey_p);
functions.description: Unpacks a packed remote key buffer to a usable rkey for the given endpoint.
requirements: ep must be valid
rkey_buffer must point to a buffer previously created by ucp_rkey_pack (or appropriate pack)
rkey_p must be a valid writable pointer
The resulting rkey is valid only on the endpoint it was unpacked on and must be destroyed with ucp_rkey_destroy

functions.name: ucp_rkey_ptr
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_rkey_ptr(ucp_rkey_h rkey, uint64_t raddr, void **addr_p);
functions.description: Returns a local pointer to remote memory reachable via shared memory for a given rkey and remote address, if possible.
requirements: rkey must be valid
raddr must be within the region described by rkey
addr_p must be a valid writable pointer
Only works if the endpoint/rkey allows shared-memory direct access; otherwise returns error

functions.name: ucp_rkey_destroy
functions.signature: void ucp_rkey_destroy(ucp_rkey_h rkey);
functions.description: Destroys a remote key object unpacked by ucp_ep_rkey_unpack and releases associated resources.
requirements: rkey must be a valid rkey created by ucp_ep_rkey_unpack
All outstanding operations using this rkey must be flushed before destruction
Destroy the rkey before destroying the endpoint it was unpacked on

functions.name: ucp_worker_set_am_recv_handler
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_worker_set_am_recv_handler(ucp_worker_h worker, const ucp_am_handler_param_t *param);
functions.description: Installs or clears a user callback to handle incoming Active Messages (AM) of a given id on a worker.
requirements: worker must be valid
param must be valid; field_mask specifies which fields (ID/FLAGS/CB/ARG) are provided
param->id must be between 0 and UINT16_MAX
Handlers set here are not compatible with ucp_am_send_nb (legacy)

functions.name: ucp_am_send_nbx
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_am_send_nbx(ucp_ep_h ep, unsigned id, const void *header, size_t header_length, const void *buffer, size_t count, const ucp_request_param_t *param);
functions.description: Sends an Active Message with a small optional header and a data payload to an endpoint. May complete immediately, return a request, or error.
requirements: ep must be valid
id must match a receiver-registered AM handler
If header is NULL, header_length must be 0
By default header must remain valid until completion unless UCP_AM_SEND_FLAG_COPY_HEADER is set
param must be valid; flags may include ucp_send_am_flags; op_attr_mask controls callback and immediate completion behavior
If UCP_OP_ATTR_FLAG_NO_IMM_CMPL is set, must return a request even on immediate completion

functions.name: ucp_am_recv_data_nbx
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_am_recv_data_nbx(ucp_worker_h worker, void *data_desc, void *buffer, size_t count, const ucp_request_param_t *param);
functions.description: Receives AM data described by data_desc into user buffer. Takes ownership of data_desc and returns completion immediately or via a request.
requirements: worker must be valid
data_desc must be a valid descriptor provided to ucp_am_recv_callback_t and marked by DATA or RNDV flags in recv_param
buffer must be a valid destination; count is number of datatype elements (defaults to bytes if datatype not set)
param must be valid; may set recv_info.length for immediate completion info
Do not call ucp_am_data_release on data_desc after calling this function

functions.name: ucp_am_data_release
functions.signature: void ucp_am_data_release(ucp_worker_h worker, void *data);
functions.description: Releases persistent AM data that was kept after the receive callback returned UCS_INPROGRESS.
requirements: worker must be valid
data must be a pointer passed to the AM receive callback and kept when returning UCS_INPROGRESS
Do not use data after release

functions.name: ucp_stream_send_nbx
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_stream_send_nbx(ucp_ep_h ep, const void *buffer, size_t count, const ucp_request_param_t *param);
functions.description: Non-blocking stream send; completes when it is safe to reuse the source buffer.
requirements: ep must be valid
buffer must remain unmodified until operation completes
count is number of datatype elements; defaults to bytes if datatype not specified
param must be valid if provided

functions.name: ucp_tag_send_nbx
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_tag_send_nbx(ucp_ep_h ep, const void *buffer, size_t count, ucp_tag_t tag, const ucp_request_param_t *param);
functions.description: Non-blocking tagged send. Completion is either immediate (return) or via callback/request.
requirements: ep must be valid
buffer must remain unmodified until completion
count is number of datatype elements; defaults to bytes if datatype not specified
param must be valid if provided

functions.name: ucp_tag_send_sync_nbx
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_tag_send_sync_nbx(ucp_ep_h ep, const void *buffer, size_t count, ucp_tag_t tag, const ucp_request_param_t *param);
functions.description: Non-blocking synchronous tagged send that completes only after a remote tag match. Always returns a request handle.
requirements: ep must be valid
buffer must remain unmodified until completion
param must be valid
Returns UCS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED if peer error handling is enabled (UCP_ERR_HANDLING_MODE_PEER)

functions.name: ucp_stream_recv_nbx
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_stream_recv_nbx(ucp_ep_h ep, void *buffer, size_t count, size_t *length, const ucp_request_param_t *param);
functions.description: Non-blocking stream receive into user buffer. Returns immediate completion with received length via length pointer, or a request.
requirements: ep must be valid
buffer must be writable for at least count elements
length must be a valid writable pointer; updated when return is NULL (immediate completion)
param may include flags such as UCP_STREAM_RECV_FLAG_WAITALL

functions.name: ucp_stream_recv_data_nb
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_stream_recv_data_nb(ucp_ep_h ep, size_t *length);
functions.description: Fetches any available stream data as a UCP-supplied buffer; returns a pointer-as-status or NULL if none.
requirements: ep must be valid
length must be a valid writable pointer when data is returned
Caller must release returned data buffer with ucp_stream_data_release after processing
Returned data is packed bytes (datatype contig(1))

functions.name: ucp_tag_recv_nbx
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_tag_recv_nbx(ucp_worker_h worker, void *buffer, size_t count, ucp_tag_t tag, ucp_tag_t tag_mask, const ucp_request_param_t *param);
functions.description: Non-blocking tagged receive that matches on tag/tag_mask and places data into buffer. May complete immediately or via request.
requirements: worker must be valid
buffer must be writable for at least count elements
count corresponds to datatype elements; defaults to bytes if datatype not specified
param may provide recv_info.tag_info to get message info on immediate completion

functions.name: ucp_tag_probe_nb
functions.signature: ucp_tag_message_h ucp_tag_probe_nb(ucp_worker_h worker, ucp_tag_t tag, ucp_tag_t tag_mask, int remove, ucp_tag_recv_info_t *info);
functions.description: Non-blocking probe for a message matching tag/mask; optionally removes it and returns a message handle.
requirements: worker must be valid
remove indicates whether to remove the message from the library (1) or just check (0)
info must be a valid writable pointer if a message is matched
Does not progress communications; caller should periodically call ucp_worker_progress for message extraction

functions.name: ucp_tag_msg_recv_nbx
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_tag_msg_recv_nbx(ucp_worker_h worker, void *buffer, size_t count, ucp_tag_message_h message, const ucp_request_param_t *param);
functions.description: Non-blocking receive for a probed message handle returned by ucp_tag_probe_nb(remove=1).
requirements: worker must be valid
buffer must be writable
message must be a valid handle returned by ucp_tag_probe_nb with remove=1
param must be valid if provided

functions.name: ucp_put_nbx
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_put_nbx(ucp_ep_h ep, const void *buffer, size_t count, uint64_t remote_addr, ucp_rkey_h rkey, const ucp_request_param_t *param);
functions.description: Non-blocking RMA put of contiguous data to remote memory. Completion indicates local buffer is reusable; remote visibility requires flushing.
requirements: ep must be valid
buffer must remain valid until completion
count is number of elements of datatype; only contig(1) supported for param->datatype per note
remote_addr/rkey must refer to a valid remote region on the target
Caller should use ucp_ep_flush_nbx/ucp_worker_flush_nbx to ensure remote completion

functions.name: ucp_get_nbx
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_get_nbx(ucp_ep_h ep, void *buffer, size_t count, uint64_t remote_addr, ucp_rkey_h rkey, const ucp_request_param_t *param);
functions.description: Non-blocking RMA get of contiguous data from remote memory into local buffer. Completion indicates local data is ready.
requirements: ep must be valid
buffer must be writable and remains reserved by UCP until completion
count is number of elements of datatype; only contig(1) supported for param->datatype per note
remote_addr/rkey must be valid

functions.name: ucp_atomic_op_nbx
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_atomic_op_nbx(ucp_ep_h ep, ucp_atomic_op_t opcode, const void *buffer, size_t count, uint64_t remote_addr, ucp_rkey_h rkey, const ucp_request_param_t *param);
functions.description: Posts a non-blocking atomic operation (add, swap, cswap, and, or, xor) on remote memory. Fetching semantics require param->reply_buffer per opcode semantics.
requirements: ep must be valid
opcode must be one of ucp_atomic_op_t
buffer must point to operand(s); for CSWAP, expected value is in buffer and new value is in param->reply_buffer per table
count must be 1; datatype must be contig(4) or contig(8) only
remote_addr and rkey must be valid
param must be valid; set reply_buffer for fetch or result as required by opcode

functions.name: ucp_request_check_status
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_request_check_status(void *request);
functions.description: Checks the current status of a non-blocking request; any status other than UCS_INPROGRESS indicates completion.
requirements: request must be a valid UCP request handle

functions.name: ucp_tag_recv_request_test
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_tag_recv_request_test(void *request, ucp_tag_recv_info_t *info);
functions.description: Checks status of a request returned by ucp_tag_recv_nb (legacy) and fills currently available receive info.
requirements: request must be a valid request from ucp_tag_recv_nb or user-allocated for ucp_tag_recv_nbr
info must be a valid writable pointer

functions.name: ucp_stream_recv_request_test
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_stream_recv_request_test(void *request, size_t *length_p);
functions.description: Checks status of a request returned by ucp_stream_recv_nb (legacy) and returns received length when completed.
requirements: request must be a valid stream receive request
length_p must be a valid writable pointer (used if status is UCS_OK)

functions.name: ucp_request_cancel
functions.signature: void ucp_request_cancel(ucp_worker_h worker, void *request);
functions.description: Attempts to cancel an outstanding communication request. Completion or cancel callback will be invoked accordingly.
requirements: worker must be valid
request must be a valid outstanding request
Application must still call ucp_request_free to release the request after completion/cancellation

functions.name: ucp_stream_data_release
functions.signature: void ucp_stream_data_release(ucp_ep_h ep, void *data);
functions.description: Releases a UCP-supplied stream data buffer previously returned by ucp_stream_recv_data_nb.
requirements: ep must be valid
data must be a pointer returned by ucp_stream_recv_data_nb
Do not use data after release

functions.name: ucp_request_free
functions.signature: void ucp_request_free(void *request);
functions.description: Releases a UCP non-blocking request back to the library; no further callbacks will occur.
requirements: request must be a valid UCP request handle (completed, canceled, or in-progress)
Caller should stop using the request handle after calling

functions.name: ucp_dt_create_generic
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_dt_create_generic(const ucp_generic_dt_ops_t *ops, void *context, ucp_datatype_t *datatype_p);
functions.description: Creates a generic datatype described by a table of pack/unpack operations for integration with higher-level datatype engines.
requirements: ops must point to a valid operations table implementing required callbacks
context is passed to ops callbacks and must remain valid as needed by ops
datatype_p must be a valid writable pointer
Caller must destroy the datatype with ucp_dt_destroy

functions.name: ucp_dt_destroy
functions.signature: void ucp_dt_destroy(ucp_datatype_t datatype);
functions.description: Destroys a datatype created by ucp_dt_create_generic and releases resources.
requirements: datatype must be created by ucp_dt_create_generic
Do not use the datatype after destruction

functions.name: ucp_dt_query
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_dt_query(ucp_datatype_t datatype, ucp_datatype_attr_t *attr);
functions.description: Queries attributes of a datatype; when PACKED_SIZE is requested, returns the packed size in bytes.
requirements: datatype must be valid
attr must be valid and writable with field_mask indicating requested fields; for PACKED_SIZE, provide buffer/count if required by datatype semantics

functions.name: ucp_worker_fence
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_worker_fence(ucp_worker_h worker);
functions.description: Ensures ordering of non-blocking operations on a worker; operations issued before this call are ordered before those issued after.
requirements: worker must be valid
Note: This does not guarantee completion; for completion use ucp_worker_flush_nbx

functions.name: ucp_worker_flush_nbx
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_worker_flush_nbx(ucp_worker_h worker, const ucp_request_param_t *param);
functions.description: Non-blocking flush of outstanding AMO and RMA operations on a worker; ensures completion at both origin and target.
requirements: worker must be valid
param must be valid if provided
Caller must progress and free returned request if not immediately completed

functions.name: ucp_ep_query
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_ep_query(ucp_ep_h ep, ucp_ep_attr_t *attr);
functions.description: Queries endpoint attributes such as name, local/remote sockaddr, transports, and user_data, based on attr->field_mask.
requirements: ep must be valid
attr must be valid and writable; field_mask selects requested fields
Requesting sockaddr fields on non-sockaddr endpoints yields UCS_ERR_NOT_CONNECTED

functions.name: ucp_request_is_completed
functions.signature: int ucp_request_is_completed(void *request);
functions.description: Deprecated helper that checks whether a UCP non-blocking request has completed. Replaced by ucp_request_test. Use for polling-style progress checking when only completion state is needed.
requirements: request must be a valid UCP request handle obtained from a UCP non-blocking API
Only use for legacy code; prefer ucp_request_test or ucp_request_check_status in new code

functions.name: ucp_request_release
functions.signature: void ucp_request_release(void *request);
functions.description: Deprecated request release function that frees a UCP request handle once it is no longer in use. Replaced by ucp_request_free.
requirements: request must be a valid UCP request handle previously returned by a UCP non-blocking API
request must not be released more than once
Do not access the request after calling this function

functions.name: ucp_ep_destroy
functions.signature: void ucp_ep_destroy(ucp_ep_h ep);
functions.description: Deprecated immediate endpoint destroy. Replaced by ucp_ep_close_nb. Closes and releases the endpoint; after return the endpoint must not be used.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
After calling this function, the endpoint must not be used

functions.name: ucp_disconnect_nb
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_disconnect_nb(ucp_ep_h ep);
functions.description: Deprecated non-blocking endpoint disconnect. Replaced by ucp_ep_close_nb. Starts closing the endpoint and may return a request to track progress.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
If a request handle is returned, the application is responsible for releasing it with ucp_request_free
If UCS_PTR_IS_ERR(...) is returned, the error code indicates transport-level failure and the endpoint can no longer be used

functions.name: ucp_request_alloc
functions.signature: void *ucp_request_alloc(ucp_worker_h worker);
functions.description: Deprecated and not implemented; always returns NULL. Users should allocate requests via standard methods such as malloc() or alloca().
requirements: None; function always returns NULL and should not be relied upon for allocation

functions.name: ucp_request_test
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_request_test(void *request, ucp_tag_recv_info_t *info);
functions.description: Deprecated generic request test. Checks completion of an outstanding UCP request and, for tag receive requests, can return additional receive info in 'info'. Replaced by ucp_tag_recv_request_test for tag receive details and ucp_request_check_status for generic completion status.
requirements: request must be a valid UCP request handle
Only pass a non-NULL 'info' if the request is from ucp_tag_recv_nb or a user-allocated request for ucp_tag_recv_nbr and you require tag-receive info
If only completion status is needed, prefer ucp_request_check_status

functions.name: ucp_rkey_pack
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_rkey_pack(ucp_context_h context, ucp_mem_h memh, void **rkey_buffer_p, size_t *size_p);
functions.description: Deprecated: pack a remote access key (RKEY) for a registered memory handle into a portable byte buffer. The buffer must be freed with ucp_rkey_buffer_release. Replaced by ucp_memh_pack.
requirements: context must be the UCP context used to allocate/map the memory handle
memh must be a valid ucp_mem_h associated with 'context'
rkey_buffer_p must be a valid pointer to receive the allocated buffer
size_p must be a valid pointer to receive the packed size in bytes
The returned buffer must be released with ucp_rkey_buffer_release
Packed RKEY must be shared with peers that will access the memory

functions.name: ucp_rkey_buffer_release
functions.signature: void ucp_rkey_buffer_release(void *rkey_buffer);
functions.description: Deprecated: release a buffer previously allocated by ucp_rkey_pack. Replaced by ucp_memh_buffer_release.
requirements: rkey_buffer must have been returned by ucp_rkey_pack
Accessing memory after it is released may cause undefined behavior
Behavior is undefined if rkey_buffer was not allocated by ucp_rkey_pack

functions.name: ucp_ep_flush
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_ep_flush(ucp_ep_h ep);
functions.description: Deprecated blocking flush of outstanding AMO and RMA operations on an endpoint. Replaced by ucp_ep_flush_nb.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle

functions.name: ucp_worker_flush
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_worker_flush(ucp_worker_h worker);
functions.description: Deprecated blocking flush of outstanding AMO and RMA operations on a worker. Ensures operations issued prior to the call are completed at origin and target. Replaced by ucp_worker_flush_nb.
requirements: worker must be a valid UCP worker handle

functions.name: ucp_put
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_put(ucp_ep_h ep, const void *buffer, size_t length, uint64_t remote_addr, ucp_rkey_h rkey);
functions.description: Deprecated blocking remote memory put. Copies 'length' bytes from local 'buffer' to 'remote_addr' using 'rkey' and returns when it is safe to reuse 'buffer'. Replaced by ucp_put_nb.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
buffer must point to at least 'length' bytes of readable memory
remote_addr and rkey must refer to a valid, accessible remote region
rkey must correspond to the remote memory region that includes remote_addr for the given length

functions.name: ucp_get
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_get(ucp_ep_h ep, void *buffer, size_t length, uint64_t remote_addr, ucp_rkey_h rkey);
functions.description: Deprecated blocking remote memory get. Loads 'length' bytes from 'remote_addr' using 'rkey' into local 'buffer' and returns when data is stored in 'buffer'. Replaced by ucp_get_nb.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
buffer must point to at least 'length' bytes of writable memory
remote_addr and rkey must refer to a valid, accessible remote region
rkey must correspond to the remote memory region that includes remote_addr for the given length

functions.name: ucp_atomic_add32
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_atomic_add32(ucp_ep_h ep, uint32_t add, uint64_t remote_addr, ucp_rkey_h rkey);
functions.description: Deprecated blocking atomic add of a 32-bit integer at a remote address. Returns after the operation is issued; remote memory contains the updated sum. Replaced by ucp_atomic_post with UCP_ATOMIC_POST_OP_ADD.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
remote_addr must be 32-bit aligned
rkey must correspond to the remote address for an accessible 32-bit location

functions.name: ucp_atomic_add64
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_atomic_add64(ucp_ep_h ep, uint64_t add, uint64_t remote_addr, ucp_rkey_h rkey);
functions.description: Deprecated blocking atomic add of a 64-bit integer at a remote address. Returns after the operation is issued; remote memory contains the updated sum. Replaced by ucp_atomic_post with UCP_ATOMIC_POST_OP_ADD.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
remote_addr must be 64-bit aligned
rkey must correspond to the remote address for an accessible 64-bit location

functions.name: ucp_atomic_fadd32
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_atomic_fadd32(ucp_ep_h ep, uint32_t add, uint64_t remote_addr, ucp_rkey_h rkey, uint32_t *result);
functions.description: Deprecated blocking atomic fetch-and-add of a 32-bit integer at a remote address. Stores the original remote value in 'result' and updates remote memory with the sum. Replaced by ucp_atomic_fetch_nb with UCP_ATOMIC_FETCH_OP_FADD.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
remote_addr must be 32-bit aligned
result must point to writable memory for a 32-bit value and remain valid until the call returns
rkey must correspond to the remote address for an accessible 32-bit location

functions.name: ucp_atomic_fadd64
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_atomic_fadd64(ucp_ep_h ep, uint64_t add, uint64_t remote_addr, ucp_rkey_h rkey, uint64_t *result);
functions.description: Deprecated blocking atomic fetch-and-add of a 64-bit integer at a remote address. Stores the original remote value in 'result' and updates remote memory with the sum. Replaced by ucp_atomic_fetch_nb with UCP_ATOMIC_FETCH_OP_FADD.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
remote_addr must be 64-bit aligned
result must point to writable memory for a 64-bit value and remain valid until the call returns
rkey must correspond to the remote address for an accessible 64-bit location

functions.name: ucp_atomic_swap32
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_atomic_swap32(ucp_ep_h ep, uint32_t swap, uint64_t remote_addr, ucp_rkey_h rkey, uint32_t *result);
functions.description: Deprecated blocking atomic swap of a 32-bit value with a remote address. Writes 'swap' to remote and returns the original remote value in 'result'. Replaced by ucp_atomic_fetch_nb with UCP_ATOMIC_FETCH_OP_SWAP.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
remote_addr must be 32-bit aligned
result must point to writable memory for a 32-bit value and remain valid until the call returns
rkey must correspond to the remote address for an accessible 32-bit location

functions.name: ucp_atomic_swap64
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_atomic_swap64(ucp_ep_h ep, uint64_t swap, uint64_t remote_addr, ucp_rkey_h rkey, uint64_t *result);
functions.description: Deprecated blocking atomic swap of a 64-bit value with a remote address. Writes 'swap' to remote and returns the original remote value in 'result'. Replaced by ucp_atomic_fetch_nb with UCP_ATOMIC_FETCH_OP_SWAP.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
remote_addr must be 64-bit aligned
result must point to writable memory for a 64-bit value and remain valid until the call returns
rkey must correspond to the remote address for an accessible 64-bit location

functions.name: ucp_atomic_cswap32
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_atomic_cswap32(ucp_ep_h ep, uint32_t compare, uint32_t swap, uint64_t remote_addr, ucp_rkey_h rkey, uint32_t *result);
functions.description: Deprecated blocking atomic compare-and-swap of a 32-bit value at a remote address. If the remote value equals 'compare', writes 'swap' to remote. The previous remote value is returned in 'result'. Replaced by ucp_atomic_fetch_nb with UCP_ATOMIC_FETCH_OP_CSWAP.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
remote_addr must be 32-bit aligned
result must point to writable memory for a 32-bit value and remain valid until the call returns
rkey must correspond to the remote address for an accessible 32-bit location

functions.name: ucp_atomic_cswap64
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_atomic_cswap64(ucp_ep_h ep, uint64_t compare, uint64_t swap, uint64_t remote_addr, ucp_rkey_h rkey, uint64_t *result);
functions.description: Deprecated blocking atomic compare-and-swap of a 64-bit value at a remote address. If the remote value equals 'compare', writes 'swap' to remote. The previous remote value is returned in 'result'. Replaced by ucp_atomic_fetch_nb with UCP_ATOMIC_FETCH_OP_CSWAP.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
remote_addr must be 64-bit aligned
result must point to writable memory for a 64-bit value and remain valid until the call returns
rkey must correspond to the remote address for an accessible 64-bit location

functions.name: ucp_ep_modify_nb
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_ep_modify_nb(ucp_ep_h ep, const ucp_ep_params_t *params);
functions.description: Non-blocking modification of certain endpoint parameters (e.g., user_data, err_handler). May complete immediately, fail, or return a request to track reconfiguration progress. Deprecated in favor of using ucp_listener_conn_handler_t for listener use-cases.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
params must point to a valid ucp_ep_params_t; only some parameters are modifiable (see ucp_ep_params_t documentation)
If a request handle is returned, the application must release it with ucp_request_free
On error (UCS_PTR_IS_ERR), the endpoint is not modified and remains usable

functions.name: ucp_worker_get_address
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_worker_get_address(ucp_worker_h worker, ucp_address_t **address_p, size_t *address_length_p);
functions.description: Deprecated: query and return a newly allocated address of a worker for connection setup. The address buffer must be released with ucp_worker_release_address. Replaced by ucp_worker_query with UCP_WORKER_ATTR_FIELD_ADDRESS.
requirements: worker must be a valid UCP worker handle
address_p must be a valid pointer to receive the allocated worker address
address_length_p must be a valid pointer to receive the address length in bytes
The returned address buffer must be released with ucp_worker_release_address

functions.name: ucp_ep_close_nb
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_ep_close_nb(ucp_ep_h ep, unsigned mode);
functions.description: Deprecated non-blocking endpoint close. Starts closing an endpoint using the specified mode (UCP_EP_CLOSE_MODE_FORCE or UCP_EP_CLOSE_MODE_FLUSH). May complete immediately, fail, or return a request to track closure. Replaced by ucp_ep_close_nbx.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
mode must be a valid ucp_ep_close_mode value
In FORCE mode, to avoid undefined behavior, UCP_ERR_HANDLING_MODE_PEER must be set on all endpoints on both sides
If a request handle is returned, the application must release it with ucp_request_free
After successful close initiation, the endpoint can no longer be used

functions.name: ucp_ep_flush_nb
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_ep_flush_nb(ucp_ep_h ep, unsigned flags, ucp_send_callback_t cb);
functions.description: Deprecated non-blocking flush of outstanding AMO and RMA operations on an endpoint. Ensures operations issued prior to the call are completed at origin and target. May complete immediately, fail, or return a request. Replaced by ucp_ep_flush_nbx.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
flags are reserved for future use (must be 0)
cb must be a valid callback pointer if a request is returned
If a request handle is returned, the application must release it with ucp_request_free

functions.name: ucp_worker_set_am_handler
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_worker_set_am_handler(ucp_worker_h worker, uint16_t id, ucp_am_callback_t cb, void *arg, uint32_t flags);
functions.description: Deprecated: install or clear a callback to handle incoming Active Messages with a given id on a worker. Use cb=NULL to clear. Only UCP_AM_FLAG_WHOLE_MSG is supported. Replaced by ucp_worker_set_am_recv_handler.
requirements: worker must be a valid UCP worker handle
id must be the Active Message id to handle
cb may be NULL to clear the handler for 'id'
flags must be supported by the worker; currently only UCP_AM_FLAG_WHOLE_MSG is supported
Returns an error code if Active Messages or requested flags are unsupported

functions.name: ucp_am_send_nb
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_am_send_nb(ucp_ep_h ep, uint16_t id, const void *buffer, size_t count, ucp_datatype_t datatype, ucp_send_callback_t cb, unsigned flags);
functions.description: Deprecated non-blocking send of an Active Message to an endpoint. Does not support CUDA memory. May complete immediately, fail, or return a request and invoke 'cb' on completion. Replaced by ucp_am_send_nbx.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
id must match a handler registered on the remote side
buffer must point to at least 'count' elements of 'datatype'
flags must comply with ucp_send_am_flags
If a request handle is returned, the application must release it with ucp_request_free

functions.name: ucp_stream_send_nb
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_stream_send_nb(ucp_ep_h ep, const void *buffer, size_t count, ucp_datatype_t datatype, ucp_send_callback_t cb, unsigned flags);
functions.description: Deprecated non-blocking stream send. Sends 'count' elements from 'buffer' described by 'datatype' to 'ep'. May complete immediately, fail, or return a request. Buffer must not be modified until completion. Replaced by ucp_stream_send_nbx.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
buffer must point to at least 'count' elements of 'datatype'
Do not modify 'buffer' until the operation completes
flags are reserved for future use (must be 0)
If a request handle is returned, the application must release it with ucp_request_free

functions.name: ucp_stream_recv_nb
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_stream_recv_nb(ucp_ep_h ep, void *buffer, size_t count, ucp_datatype_t datatype, ucp_stream_recv_callback_t cb, size_t *length, unsigned flags);
functions.description: Deprecated non-blocking stream receive into a user buffer. Receives up to 'count' elements into 'buffer'; completion is reported by return code or callback. On UCS_OK return, '*length' holds the received byte count. Replaced by ucp_stream_recv_nbx.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
buffer must point to writable storage for at least 'count' elements of 'datatype'
cb must be a valid callback pointer if the operation cannot complete immediately
length is only valid if the return code is UCS_OK
flags must be from ucp_stream_recv_flags_t
If a request handle is returned, the application must release it with ucp_request_free

functions.name: ucp_tag_send_nb
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_tag_send_nb(ucp_ep_h ep, const void *buffer, size_t count, ucp_datatype_t datatype, ucp_tag_t tag, ucp_send_callback_t cb);
functions.description: Deprecated non-blocking tagged send. Sends a message tagged with 'tag' from 'buffer' to 'ep'. May complete immediately, fail, or return a request and invoke 'cb' on completion. Replaced by ucp_tag_send_nbx.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
buffer must point to at least 'count' elements of 'datatype'
Do not modify 'buffer' until the operation completes
If a request handle is returned, the application must release it with ucp_request_free

functions.name: ucp_tag_send_nbr
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_tag_send_nbr(ucp_ep_h ep, const void *buffer, size_t count, ucp_datatype_t datatype, ucp_tag_t tag, void *req);
functions.description: Deprecated non-blocking tagged send with user-provided request, optimized for blocking-style usage. Always uses eager up to a higher rendezvous threshold and avoids callbacks. Replaced by ucp_tag_send_nbx with UCP_OP_ATTR_FIELD_REQUEST.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
buffer must point to at least 'count' elements of 'datatype' and must not be modified until completion
req must be a user-allocated request buffer with at least UCP request size bytes available before 'req' (size obtainable via ucp_context_query)
On UCS_INPROGRESS return, the caller must monitor completion via ucp_request_check_status

functions.name: ucp_tag_send_sync_nb
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_tag_send_sync_nb(ucp_ep_h ep, const void *buffer, size_t count, ucp_datatype_t datatype, ucp_tag_t tag, ucp_send_callback_t cb);
functions.description: Deprecated non-blocking synchronous tagged send. Completes only after a remote tag match is performed. Never completes in-place; always returns a request. Replaced by ucp_tag_send_sync_nbx.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
buffer must point to at least 'count' elements of 'datatype' and must not be modified until completion
May return UCS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED if UCP_ERR_HANDLING_MODE_PEER is enabled
The returned request must be released with ucp_request_free

functions.name: ucp_tag_recv_nb
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_tag_recv_nb(ucp_worker_h worker, void *buffer, size_t count, ucp_datatype_t datatype, ucp_tag_t tag, ucp_tag_t tag_mask, ucp_tag_recv_callback_t cb);
functions.description: Deprecated non-blocking tagged receive that posts a receive on a worker matching 'tag'/'tag_mask'. Always returns a request or error (never UCS_OK). Completion is reported via callback. Replaced by ucp_tag_recv_nbx.
requirements: worker must be a valid UCP worker handle
buffer must point to writable storage for at least 'count' elements of 'datatype'
tag and tag_mask define matching; only bits set in tag_mask are matched
This function cannot return UCS_OK; it returns a request or an error
The returned request must be released with ucp_request_free

functions.name: ucp_tag_recv_nbr
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_tag_recv_nbr(ucp_worker_h worker, void *buffer, size_t count, ucp_datatype_t datatype, ucp_tag_t tag, ucp_tag_t tag_mask, void *req);
functions.description: Deprecated non-blocking tagged receive with user-provided request. Completion must be checked via ucp_request_check_status or ucp_tag_recv_request_test. Replaced by ucp_tag_recv_nbx with UCP_OP_ATTR_FIELD_REQUEST.
requirements: worker must be a valid UCP worker handle
buffer must point to writable storage for at least 'count' elements of 'datatype'
tag and tag_mask define matching; only bits set in tag_mask are matched
req must be a user-allocated request buffer with at least UCP request size bytes available before 'req' (size obtainable via ucp_context_query)

functions.name: ucp_tag_msg_recv_nb
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_tag_msg_recv_nb(ucp_worker_h worker, void *buffer, size_t count, ucp_datatype_t datatype, ucp_tag_message_h message, ucp_tag_recv_callback_t cb);
functions.description: Deprecated non-blocking receive for a probed message. Consumes a message handle obtained via ucp_tag_probe_nb and posts a receive into 'buffer'. May return a request or error. Replaced by ucp_tag_recv_nbx.
requirements: worker must be a valid UCP worker handle
buffer must point to writable storage for at least 'count' elements of 'datatype'
message must be a valid message handle obtained from ucp_tag_probe_nb
The returned request must be released with ucp_request_free

functions.name: ucp_put_nbi
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_put_nbi(ucp_ep_h ep, const void *buffer, size_t length, uint64_t remote_addr, ucp_rkey_h rkey);
functions.description: Deprecated implicit non-blocking remote put without callback. Initiates copying 'length' bytes from 'buffer' to 'remote_addr' and returns immediately; buffer reusability is not guaranteed. Use a flush to ensure completion. Replaced by ucp_put_nbx (without callback attribute).
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
buffer must point to at least 'length' bytes of readable memory
remote_addr and rkey must refer to a valid, accessible remote region
To guarantee reusability of 'buffer', the application must flush the endpoint or worker

functions.name: ucp_put_nb
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_put_nb(ucp_ep_h ep, const void *buffer, size_t length, uint64_t remote_addr, ucp_rkey_h rkey, ucp_send_callback_t cb);
functions.description: Deprecated non-blocking remote put with completion callback. Initiates copying 'length' bytes from 'buffer' to 'remote_addr'. May complete immediately, fail, or return a request and invoke 'cb' on completion. Replaced by ucp_put_nbx.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
buffer must point to at least 'length' bytes of readable memory
remote_addr and rkey must refer to a valid, accessible remote region
If a request handle is returned, the application must release it with ucp_request_free
Use ucp_worker_flush_nb if you need to guarantee buffer reusability

functions.name: ucp_get_nbi
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_get_nbi(ucp_ep_h ep, void *buffer, size_t length, uint64_t remote_addr, ucp_rkey_h rkey);
functions.description: Deprecated implicit non-blocking remote get without callback. Initiates loading 'length' bytes from 'remote_addr' into 'buffer' and returns immediately; local visibility is not guaranteed until flushed. Replaced by ucp_get_nbx (without callback attribute).
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
buffer must point to at least 'length' bytes of writable memory
remote_addr and rkey must refer to a valid, accessible remote region
To guarantee that data is visible in 'buffer', the application must flush the worker

functions.name: ucp_get_nb
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_get_nb(ucp_ep_h ep, void *buffer, size_t length, uint64_t remote_addr, ucp_rkey_h rkey, ucp_send_callback_t cb);
functions.description: Deprecated non-blocking remote get with completion callback. Initiates loading 'length' bytes from 'remote_addr' into 'buffer'. May complete immediately, fail, or return a request and invoke 'cb' on completion. Replaced by ucp_get_nbx.
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
buffer must point to at least 'length' bytes of writable memory
remote_addr and rkey must refer to a valid, accessible remote region
If a request handle is returned, the application must release it with ucp_request_free

functions.name: ucp_atomic_post
functions.signature: ucs_status_t ucp_atomic_post(ucp_ep_h ep, ucp_atomic_post_op_t opcode, uint64_t value, size_t op_size, uint64_t remote_addr, ucp_rkey_h rkey);
functions.description: Deprecated non-fetching atomic operation on remote memory (e.g., add/and/or/xor). Returns after posting; completion must be ensured via endpoint/worker flush. Replaced by ucp_atomic_op_nbx (without reply buffer).
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
opcode must be a valid ucp_atomic_post_op_t
op_size must match the size of the operand in bytes (e.g., 4 or 8) and the remote location's width
remote_addr and rkey must refer to a valid, accessible remote location of size op_size
Completion is not guaranteed on return; use ucp_ep_flush_nb or ucp_worker_flush_nb to ensure remote update is visible

functions.name: ucp_atomic_fetch_nb
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_atomic_fetch_nb(ucp_ep_h ep, ucp_atomic_fetch_op_t opcode, uint64_t value, void *result, size_t op_size, uint64_t remote_addr, ucp_rkey_h rkey, ucp_send_callback_t cb);
functions.description: Deprecated non-blocking fetching atomic operation on remote memory (e.g., FADD, SWAP, CSWAP, FAND, FOR, FXOR). May complete immediately, fail, or return a request; 'result' holds the fetched value upon completion. Replaced by ucp_atomic_op_nbx (with reply buffer attribute).
requirements: ep must be a valid UCP endpoint handle
opcode must be a valid ucp_atomic_fetch_op_t
result must point to writable memory suitable for the operation and 'op_size' and must remain valid until completion
op_size must match the operand size in bytes and the remote location's width
remote_addr and rkey must refer to a valid, accessible remote location of size op_size
Do not modify memory pointed to by 'result' until the operation completes
If a request handle is returned, the application must release it with ucp_request_free

functions.name: ucp_worker_flush_nb
functions.signature: ucs_status_ptr_t ucp_worker_flush_nb(ucp_worker_h worker, unsigned flags, ucp_send_callback_t cb);
functions.description: Deprecated non-blocking flush of outstanding AMO and RMA operations on a worker. Ensures all preceding operations are completed at origin and target. May complete immediately, fail, or return a request. Replaced by ucp_worker_flush_nbx.
requirements: worker must be a valid UCP worker handle
flags are reserved for future use (must be 0)
cb must be a valid callback pointer if a request is returned
If a request handle is returned, the application must release it with ucp_request_free

functions.name: uct_md_mem_query
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_md_mem_query(uct_md_h md, const void *address, size_t length, uct_md_mem_attr_t *mem_attr);
functions.description: Query attributes (memory type, base address, allocation length, sys device, dmabuf info) for a given pointer range on a memory domain. Used to discover properties of a pointer for later registration or access decisions.
requirements: md must be a valid, open memory domain that recognizes the pointer or an error is returned.
address must be non-NULL.
length must be > 0.
mem_attr must point to a uct_md_mem_attr_t whose field_mask indicates requested fields; returns UCS_OK if at least one attribute is provided.

functions.name: uct_query_components
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_query_components(uct_component_h **components_p, unsigned *num_components_p);
functions.description: Return a dynamically allocated array of available UCT components and its count.
requirements: components_p must be non-NULL and will be set to an allocated array that must be released with uct_release_component_list().
num_components_p must be non-NULL.

functions.name: uct_release_component_list
functions.signature: void uct_release_component_list(uct_component_h *components);
functions.description: Release the array returned by uct_query_components.
requirements: components must be a pointer returned by uct_query_components and not NULL if there are elements.
Do not use components after this call.

functions.name: uct_component_query
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_component_query(uct_component_h component, uct_component_attr_t *component_attr);
functions.description: Query attributes of a component (name, MD resources, flags). Field-mask-driven.
requirements: component must be a valid component handle obtained via uct_query_components.
component_attr must be non-NULL and have field_mask set to the requested fields.
If requesting MD resources, preallocate md_resources array as documented and/or query twice to get count then entries.

functions.name: uct_md_open
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_md_open(uct_component_h component, const char *md_name, const uct_md_config_t *config, uct_md_h *md_p);
functions.description: Open a memory domain by name on a given component using provided configuration.
requirements: component must be valid.
md_name must match a memory domain name on the component (from uct_component_query).
config must be a valid md config (e.g., from uct_md_config_read) or an MD-specific extension.
md_p must be non-NULL; receives an opened MD handle that must be closed by uct_md_close().

functions.name: uct_md_close
functions.signature: void uct_md_close(uct_md_h md);
functions.description: Close and destroy a memory domain previously opened by uct_md_open.
requirements: md must be a valid handle returned by uct_md_open and not already closed.
All resources created on this MD that require the MD to exist should be cleaned up beforehand.

functions.name: uct_md_query_tl_resources
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_md_query_tl_resources(uct_md_h md, uct_tl_resource_desc_t **resources_p, unsigned *num_resources_p);
functions.description: Query transport layer resources available for a memory domain.
requirements: md must be valid.
resources_p must be non-NULL and will be set to an allocated array released with uct_release_tl_resource_list().
num_resources_p must be non-NULL.

functions.name: uct_release_tl_resource_list
functions.signature: void uct_release_tl_resource_list(uct_tl_resource_desc_t *resources);
functions.description: Release the resource list returned by uct_md_query_tl_resources.
requirements: resources must be the pointer returned by uct_md_query_tl_resources.
Do not access resources after releasing.

functions.name: uct_worker_create
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_worker_create(ucs_async_context_t *async, ucs_thread_mode_t thread_mode, uct_worker_h *worker_p);
functions.description: Create a UCT worker (progress engine) bound to an async context and with a specific thread mode.
requirements: async must be non-NULL and initialized.
thread_mode must be a valid ucs_thread_mode_t suitable for the calling pattern.
worker_p must be non-NULL; receives a worker that must be destroyed with uct_worker_destroy().

functions.name: uct_worker_destroy
functions.signature: void uct_worker_destroy(uct_worker_h worker);
functions.description: Destroy a UCT worker created by uct_worker_create.
requirements: worker must be a valid worker handle and not already destroyed.
Caller must ensure no other threads are concurrently using this worker unless API guarantees thread-safety for destroy.

functions.name: uct_worker_progress_register_safe
functions.signature: void uct_worker_progress_register_safe(uct_worker_h worker, ucs_callback_t func, void *arg, unsigned flags, uct_worker_cb_id_t *id_p);
functions.description: Register a slow-path callback to be invoked on worker progress; stores an identifier to later unregister. Thread-safe.
requirements: worker must be valid.
func must be a valid callback function pointer.
id_p must be non-NULL; if *id_p == UCS_CALLBACKQ_ID_NULL a new callback is added and id stored; otherwise no-op.
flags must be valid ucs_callbackq_flags per UCS API.

functions.name: uct_worker_progress_unregister_safe
functions.signature: void uct_worker_progress_unregister_safe(uct_worker_h worker, uct_worker_cb_id_t *id_p);
functions.description: Unregister a previously registered slow-path callback by id. Thread-safe.
requirements: worker must be valid.
id_p must be non-NULL; if *id_p != UCS_CALLBACKQ_ID_NULL, the corresponding callback is removed and *id_p set to UCS_CALLBACKQ_ID_NULL.

functions.name: uct_md_iface_config_read
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_md_iface_config_read(uct_md_h md, const char *tl_name, const char *env_prefix, const char *filename, uct_iface_config_t **config_p);
functions.description: Read transport interface configuration for a transport registered with an MD. Supports device or sockaddr modes based on tl_name and MD capabilities.
requirements: md must be valid.
config_p must be non-NULL and will be set to an allocated config released by uct_config_release().
tl_name may be NULL only if the MD supports UCT_MD_FLAG_SOCKADDR; otherwise must specify a transport name.
env_prefix may be NULL to use default variable prefix.
filename may be NULL; if non-NULL and missing, it is ignored.

functions.name: uct_config_release
functions.signature: void uct_config_release(void *config);
functions.description: Release configuration memory returned by uct_md_iface_config_read, uct_md_config_read, or uct_cm_config_read.
requirements: config must be a pointer returned by one of the config read functions.
Do not access config after release.

functions.name: uct_config_get
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_config_get(void *config, const char *name, char *value, size_t max);
functions.description: Get the string value of a configuration option by name from an MD/iface/CM config object.
requirements: config must be a valid configuration object.
name must be a non-NULL configuration variable name.
value must point to caller-allocated buffer; max specifies its capacity > 0.

functions.name: uct_config_modify
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_config_modify(void *config, const char *name, const char *value);
functions.description: Modify a configuration option by name on an MD/iface/CM configuration object.
requirements: config must be a valid configuration object.
name must be a non-NULL configuration variable name.
value must be non-NULL and valid for the option.

functions.name: uct_iface_open
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_iface_open(uct_md_h md, uct_worker_h worker, const uct_iface_params_t *params, const uct_iface_config_t *config, uct_iface_h *iface_p);
functions.description: Open a transport interface on a memory domain and worker using provided params and config.
requirements: md and worker must be valid.
params must be non-NULL and have field_mask indicating provided fields; open_mode and mode sub-struct must be set appropriately.
config must be obtained via uct_md_iface_config_read or be a transport-specific extension.
iface_p must be non-NULL; receives an interface to be closed by uct_iface_close().

functions.name: uct_iface_close
functions.signature: void uct_iface_close(uct_iface_h iface);
functions.description: Close and destroy a transport interface created by uct_iface_open.
requirements: iface must be a valid, open interface.
Ensure no outstanding operations require the interface unless the transport supports safe shutdown semantics.

functions.name: uct_iface_query
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_iface_query(uct_iface_h iface, uct_iface_attr_t *iface_attr);
functions.description: Query interface capabilities, limits, and performance attributes.
requirements: iface must be valid.
iface_attr must be non-NULL.

functions.name: uct_iface_get_device_address
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_iface_get_device_address(uct_iface_h iface, uct_device_addr_t *addr);
functions.description: Get the device address associated with an interface.
requirements: iface must be valid.
addr must point to a buffer at least iface_attr.device_addr_len bytes long.

functions.name: uct_iface_get_address
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_iface_get_address(uct_iface_h iface, uct_iface_addr_t *addr);
functions.description: Get the interface address (requires CONNECT_TO_IFACE capability).
requirements: iface must be valid and support UCT_IFACE_FLAG_CONNECT_TO_IFACE.
addr must point to a buffer at least iface_attr.iface_addr_len bytes long.

functions.name: uct_iface_is_reachable
functions.signature: int uct_iface_is_reachable(const uct_iface_h iface, const uct_device_addr_t *dev_addr, const uct_iface_addr_t *iface_addr);
functions.description: Check if a remote interface address is locally reachable from this interface. Local heuristic; does not guarantee successful communication.
requirements: iface must be valid.
If iface_attr.dev_addr_len != 0, dev_addr must be non-NULL; otherwise must be NULL.
If iface_attr.iface_addr_len != 0, iface_addr must be non-NULL; otherwise must be NULL.

functions.name: uct_ep_check
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_ep_check(const uct_ep_h ep, unsigned flags, uct_completion_t *comp);
functions.description: Probe endpoint liveness with respect to the UCT library. May complete immediately or asynchronously via completion.
requirements: ep must be a valid endpoint.
flags currently unsupported; set to 0.
If status not known, returns UCS_INPROGRESS and comp (if non-NULL) will be used to report status.

functions.name: uct_iface_event_fd_get
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_iface_event_fd_get(uct_iface_h iface, int *fd_p);
functions.description: Obtain a notification file descriptor for event-driven progress on interfaces that support event flags.
requirements: iface must support at least one UCT_IFACE_FLAG_EVENT* capability.
fd_p must be non-NULL.

functions.name: uct_iface_event_arm
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_iface_event_arm(uct_iface_h iface, unsigned events);
functions.description: Arm an interface to trigger the event notification FD on specific events. Must be called before waiting for each event.
requirements: iface must be valid and support event notification.
events must be a combination from uct_iface_event_types.
Caller must handle UCS_ERR_BUSY indicating unprocessed events prevent arming.

functions.name: uct_iface_mem_alloc
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_iface_mem_alloc(uct_iface_h iface, size_t length, unsigned flags, const char *name, uct_allocated_memory_t *mem);
functions.description: Allocate memory suitable for zero-copy on a specific interface.
requirements: iface must be valid.
length is the requested size; must be > 0.
flags are uct_md_mem_flags; ensure compatibility with the interface/MD.
name may be NULL or debug string.
mem must be non-NULL; on success fields are filled and must be freed with uct_iface_mem_free().

functions.name: uct_iface_mem_free
functions.signature: void uct_iface_mem_free(const uct_allocated_memory_t *mem);
functions.description: Free memory allocated by uct_iface_mem_alloc.
requirements: mem must be a descriptor previously returned by uct_iface_mem_alloc.
Do not use the memory after freeing.

functions.name: uct_iface_set_am_handler
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_iface_set_am_handler(uct_iface_h iface, uint8_t id, uct_am_callback_t cb, void *arg, uint32_t flags);
functions.description: Install or clear an Active Message callback handler for a given AM id on an interface.
requirements: iface must be valid and support AM.
id must be in range 0..UCT_AM_ID_MAX-1.
cb may be NULL to clear the handler.
flags must be compatible with interface callback capabilities (UCT_IFACE_FLAG_CB_SYNC/ASYNC).

functions.name: uct_iface_set_am_tracer
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_iface_set_am_tracer(uct_iface_h iface, uct_am_tracer_t tracer, void *arg);
functions.description: Set or clear an AM tracer function for debug printing of AMs when data tracing is enabled.
requirements: iface must be valid.
tracer may be NULL to clear.

functions.name: uct_iface_accept
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_iface_accept(uct_iface_h iface, uct_conn_request_h conn_request);
functions.description: Accept a connection request received by an interface in sockaddr server mode.
requirements: iface must be the interface that produced conn_request.
conn_request must be a valid, pending request from the connection request callback.
Caller must manage endpoint creation separately as needed.

functions.name: uct_iface_reject
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_iface_reject(uct_iface_h iface, uct_conn_request_h conn_request);
functions.description: Reject a connection request received by an interface and invoke remote error handler if set.
requirements: iface must be the interface that produced conn_request.
conn_request must be valid and not already consumed.

functions.name: uct_ep_create
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_ep_create(const uct_ep_params_t *params, uct_ep_h *ep_p);
functions.description: Create an endpoint in unconnected mode, connected to an interface, or connected via sockaddr/CM, based on params.
requirements: params must be non-NULL with field_mask set and either iface or cm specified, not both.
For CONNECT_TO_IFACE: dev_addr and iface_addr must be set; iface must support UCT_IFACE_FLAG_CONNECT_TO_IFACE.
For CONNECT_TO_EP: create unconnected EP then call uct_ep_connect_to_ep; iface must support UCT_IFACE_FLAG_CONNECT_TO_EP.

For sockaddr: sockaddr must be set and iface supports UCT_IFACE_FLAG_CONNECT_TO_SOCKADDR or cm provided; related callbacks/flags subject to params rules (mutual exclusivity with private_data/callbacks).
ep_p must be non-NULL.

functions.name: uct_ep_connect
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_ep_connect(uct_ep_h ep, const uct_ep_connect_params_t *params);
functions.description: On client side, continue connection after address resolution and send private data to peer.
requirements: ep must be a client-side endpoint for CM-based connection; called after cm_resolve_cb.
params must be non-NULL with field_mask set to provided fields.
private_data_length must not exceed cm_attr.max_conn_priv when provided.

functions.name: uct_ep_disconnect
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_ep_disconnect(uct_ep_h ep, unsigned flags);
functions.description: Initiate disconnect on a CM-connected endpoint; sends a notification so the remote disconnect callback is invoked. Endpoint becomes unusable afterward.
requirements: ep must be connected via sockaddr/CM.
flags are reserved; set to 0.
After calling, do not use ep for communications; call uct_ep_destroy after disconnect callback fires.
Caller may need to ensure flushes to guarantee delivery of the notification.

functions.name: uct_ep_destroy
functions.signature: void uct_ep_destroy(uct_ep_h ep);
functions.description: Destroy an endpoint and release its resources.
requirements: ep must be a valid endpoint handle and not used concurrently.
If destroying before disconnect, disconnect callbacks will not be invoked.

functions.name: uct_ep_get_address
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_ep_get_address(uct_ep_h ep, uct_ep_addr_t *addr);
functions.description: Get the address of an endpoint for peer connections.
requirements: ep must be valid.
addr must point to a buffer of at least iface_attr.ep_addr_len bytes.

functions.name: uct_ep_connect_to_ep
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_ep_connect_to_ep(uct_ep_h ep, const uct_device_addr_t *dev_addr, const uct_ep_addr_t *ep_addr);
functions.description: Connect an endpoint to a specific remote endpoint (CONNECT_TO_EP capability required).
requirements: ep must be a valid unconnected EP on an interface that supports UCT_IFACE_FLAG_CONNECT_TO_EP.
dev_addr and ep_addr must be valid addresses obtained from the remote interface/EP.

functions.name: uct_md_query
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_md_query(uct_md_h md, uct_md_attr_t *md_attr);
functions.description: Query memory domain attributes (caps, limits, costs, CPU affinity, etc.).
requirements: md must be valid.
md_attr must be non-NULL.

functions.name: uct_md_mem_advise
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_md_mem_advise(uct_md_h md, uct_mem_h memh, void *addr, size_t length, uct_mem_advice_t advice);
functions.description: Provide usage advice for a registered/allocated memory region to potentially optimize performance.
requirements: md must be the MD that allocated or registered memh.
memh must be a valid memory handle from uct_mem_alloc or uct_md_mem_reg on this md.
addr/length must describe a range within memh; length > 0.
advice must be a valid uct_mem_advice_t.

functions.name: uct_md_mem_reg
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_md_mem_reg(uct_md_h md, void *address, size_t length, unsigned flags, uct_mem_h *memh_p);
