functions.description: Register user memory for zero-copy remote/local access on an MD.
requirements: md must support UCT_MD_FLAG_REG.
address must be non-NULL.
length must be > 0.
flags are uct_md_mem_flags; include access bits appropriate for intended use.
memh_p must be non-NULL; on success must be deregistered with uct_md_mem_dereg().

functions.name: uct_md_mem_dereg
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_md_mem_dereg(uct_md_h md, uct_mem_h memh);
functions.description: Deregister memory that was registered with uct_md_mem_reg.
requirements: md must be the same MD used for registration.
memh must be a valid handle obtained from uct_md_mem_reg and not already deregistered.

functions.name: uct_md_detect_memory_type
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_md_detect_memory_type(uct_md_h md, const void *addr, size_t length, ucs_memory_type_t *mem_type_p);
functions.description: Detect the memory type of an address range on a given MD.
requirements: md must be valid.
addr must be non-NULL.
length must be > 0.
mem_type_p must be non-NULL to receive the detected type.

functions.name: uct_mem_alloc
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_mem_alloc(size_t length, const uct_alloc_method_t *methods, unsigned num_methods, const uct_mem_alloc_params_t *params, uct_allocated_memory_t *mem);
functions.description: Allocate memory suitable for zero-copy/remote access using a sequence of allocation methods and options.
requirements: length must be > 0.
methods must be a non-NULL array of length num_methods > 0; each method is tried in order; MD method consults params->mds.
params must be non-NULL; field_mask controls which fields are used; defaults apply if fields are omitted.
mem must be non-NULL; on success must be freed with uct_mem_free().

functions.name: uct_mem_free
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_mem_free(const uct_allocated_memory_t *mem);
functions.description: Free memory previously allocated by uct_mem_alloc.
requirements: mem must describe a region returned by uct_mem_alloc.
Do not use memory after freeing.

functions.name: uct_md_config_read
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_md_config_read(uct_component_h component, const char *env_prefix, const char *filename, uct_md_config_t **config_p);
functions.description: Read configuration for a memory domain on a given component.
requirements: component must be valid.
config_p must be non-NULL and will receive an allocated config to be released with uct_config_release().
env_prefix may be NULL for default prefix.
filename may be NULL; nonexistent files are ignored.

functions.name: uct_md_is_sockaddr_accessible
functions.signature: int uct_md_is_sockaddr_accessible(uct_md_h md, const ucs_sock_addr_t *sockaddr, uct_sockaddr_accessibility_t mode);
functions.description: Check if a socket address is accessible from an MD locally (bind) or remotely (connect).
requirements: md must support UCT_MD_FLAG_SOCKADDR.
sockaddr must be non-NULL and valid.
mode must be UCT_SOCKADDR_ACC_LOCAL or UCT_SOCKADDR_ACC_REMOTE.

functions.name: uct_md_mkey_pack
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_md_mkey_pack(uct_md_h md, uct_mem_h memh, void *rkey_buffer);
functions.description: Pack a remote key for a registered/allocated memory handle for remote access.
requirements: md must be valid.
memh must be a local memory handle from this md.
rkey_buffer must point to a buffer with at least md_attr.rkey_packed_size bytes.

functions.name: uct_rkey_unpack
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_rkey_unpack(uct_component_h component, const void *rkey_buffer, uct_rkey_bundle_t *rkey_ob);
functions.description: Unpack a packed remote key on a component and return a bundle usable for RMA/AMO.
requirements: component must be capable of unpacking the key; must match the component used to pack the key.
rkey_buffer must point to a valid packed rkey buffer.
rkey_ob must be non-NULL and will receive the unpacked key; release with uct_rkey_release().

functions.name: uct_rkey_ptr
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_rkey_ptr(uct_component_h component, uct_rkey_bundle_t *rkey_ob, uint64_t remote_addr, void **addr_p);
functions.description: Obtain a direct local pointer to remote memory described by an rkey on components that support direct mapping (UCT_COMPONENT_FLAG_RKEY_PTR).
requirements: component must support UCT_COMPONENT_FLAG_RKEY_PTR and be the same used to pack the rkey.
rkey_ob must be a valid bundle from uct_rkey_unpack.
remote_addr must be within the remote memory range.
addr_p must be non-NULL to receive the local pointer.

functions.name: uct_rkey_release
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_rkey_release(uct_component_h component, const uct_rkey_bundle_t *rkey_ob);
functions.description: Release resources associated with an unpacked rkey bundle.
requirements: component must be the same used to unpack the rkey.
rkey_ob must be a valid bundle previously returned by uct_rkey_unpack and not yet released.

functions.name: uct_cm_open
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_cm_open(uct_component_h component, uct_worker_h worker, const uct_cm_config_t *config, uct_cm_h *cm_p);
functions.description: Open a connection manager on a component and worker using CM configuration.
requirements: component and worker must be valid.
config must be a valid CM config (from uct_cm_config_read or extension).
cm_p must be non-NULL; result must be closed with uct_cm_close().

functions.name: uct_cm_close
functions.signature: void uct_cm_close(uct_cm_h cm);
functions.description: Close a connection manager opened by uct_cm_open.
requirements: cm must be valid and not already closed.
All listeners/endpoints associated with this CM should be destroyed first.

functions.name: uct_cm_query
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_cm_query(uct_cm_h cm, uct_cm_attr_t *cm_attr);
functions.description: Query connection manager attributes (e.g., max private data).
requirements: cm must be valid.
cm_attr must be non-NULL and have field_mask indicating requested fields.

functions.name: uct_cm_config_read
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_cm_config_read(uct_component_h component, const char *env_prefix, const char *filename, uct_cm_config_t **config_p);
functions.description: Read a component-specific CM configuration object.
requirements: component must be valid.
config_p must be non-NULL and will receive an allocated config released by uct_config_release().
env_prefix may be NULL for default.
filename may be NULL; unreadable file is ignored.

functions.name: uct_cm_client_ep_conn_notify
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_cm_client_ep_conn_notify(uct_ep_h ep);
functions.description: Client-side notification to server that connection establishment completed.
requirements: ep must be a connected client endpoint associated with a CM.
Must be called after client connection completion.

functions.name: uct_listener_create
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_listener_create(uct_cm_h cm, const struct sockaddr *saddr, socklen_t socklen, const uct_listener_params_t *params, uct_listener_h *listener_p);
functions.description: Create a listener on a CM to accept incoming connections at the given socket address.
requirements: cm must be valid and remain open while the listener exists.
saddr/socklen must specify a valid local address to bind/listen on.
params must be non-NULL; field_mask indicates provided fields. If backlog provided, it must be positive. Callback and user_data may be provided.
listener_p must be non-NULL; result must be destroyed with uct_listener_destroy().

functions.name: uct_listener_destroy
functions.signature: void uct_listener_destroy(uct_listener_h listener);
functions.description: Destroy a listener created by uct_listener_create.
requirements: listener must be valid.
No more operations should reference this listener after destruction.

functions.name: uct_listener_reject
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_listener_reject(uct_listener_h listener, uct_conn_request_h conn_request);
functions.description: Reject a connection request received via a listener.
requirements: listener must be valid and the one that delivered conn_request.
conn_request must be a valid pending request not yet consumed.

functions.name: uct_listener_reject
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_listener_reject(uct_listener_h listener, uct_conn_request_h conn_request);
functions.description: Reject a connection request received via a listener (duplicate entry).
requirements: listener must be valid and the one that delivered conn_request.
conn_request must be a valid pending request not yet consumed.

functions.name: uct_listener_query
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_listener_query(uct_listener_h listener, uct_listener_attr_t *listener_attr);
functions.description: Query listener attributes such as bound sockaddr.
requirements: listener must be valid.
listener_attr must be non-NULL and have field_mask set to requested attributes.

functions.name: uct_listener_query
functions.signature: ucs_status_t uct_listener_query(uct_listener_h listener, uct_listener_attr_t *listener_attr);
functions.description: Query listener attributes (duplicate entry).
requirements: listener must be valid.
listener_attr must be non-NULL and have field_mask set to requested attributes.

functions.name: uct_worker_progress
functions.signature: UCT_INLINE_API unsigned uct_worker_progress(uct_worker_h worker);
functions.description: Explicitly progress communications and AM handling on a worker; returns whether any work was progressed.
requirements: worker must be valid.
Caller is responsible for calling this periodically to drive progress if needed.

functions.name: uct_iface_flush
functions.signature: UCT_INLINE_API ucs_status_t uct_iface_flush(uct_iface_h iface, unsigned flags, uct_completion_t *comp);
functions.description: Flush outstanding operations on an interface according to flags (local/remote semantics).
requirements: iface must be valid.
flags controls semantics; UCT_FLUSH_FLAG_LOCAL always supported; other flags per iface capabilities.
If returns UCS_INPROGRESS and comp != NULL, comp will be completed later; comp->status initialized to UCS_OK by caller.

functions.name: uct_iface_fence
functions.signature: UCT_INLINE_API ucs_status_t uct_iface_fence(uct_iface_h iface, unsigned flags);
functions.description: Insert ordering so ops before the fence complete before ops after the fence on the same interface.
requirements: iface must be valid.
flags currently unsupported; pass 0.

functions.name: uct_iface_release_desc
functions.signature: UCT_INLINE_API void uct_iface_release_desc(void *desc);
functions.description: Release an AM receive descriptor previously delivered to an AM callback with UCT_CB_PARAM_FLAG_DESC.
requirements: desc must be a valid descriptor pointer passed to an AM callback and currently owned by the callee.
Must not use desc after release.

functions.name: uct_ep_put_short
functions.signature: UCT_INLINE_API ucs_status_t uct_ep_put_short(uct_ep_h ep, const void *buffer, unsigned length, uint64_t remote_addr, uct_rkey_t rkey);
functions.description: RMA PUT using short protocol: copy payload from buffer and write to remote address.
requirements: ep must be valid and connected for RMA.
length must not exceed iface_attr.cap.put.max_short.
remote_addr and rkey must refer to a valid remote memory region with remote write access.

functions.name: uct_ep_put_bcopy
functions.signature: UCT_INLINE_API ssize_t uct_ep_put_bcopy(uct_ep_h ep, uct_pack_callback_t pack_cb, void *arg, uint64_t remote_addr, uct_rkey_t rkey);
functions.description: RMA PUT using bcopy protocol: user pack_cb fills network buffer; returns packed length or error.
requirements: ep must be valid.
pack_cb must be non-NULL and copy data into a provided buffer.
Total packed length must be <= iface_attr.cap.put.max_bcopy.
remote_addr/rkey must be valid for remote write.

functions.name: uct_ep_put_zcopy
functions.signature: UCT_INLINE_API ucs_status_t uct_ep_put_zcopy(uct_ep_h ep, const uct_iov_t *iov, size_t iovcnt, uint64_t remote_addr, uct_rkey_t rkey, uct_completion_t *comp);
functions.description: RMA PUT zero-copy: gather from registered iov and write to remote address; may complete asynchronously.
requirements: ep must be valid.
iov must point to valid array of iovcnt entries; iovcnt <= iface_attr.cap.put.max_iov.
Total length within iface_attr.cap.put.{min_zcopy..max_zcopy}.
Local buffers must meet registration/align requirements (opt_zcopy_align/align_mtu).
remote_addr/rkey valid for write.
If returns UCS_INPROGRESS, do not modify buffers until comp completes.

functions.name: uct_ep_get_short
functions.signature: UCT_INLINE_API ucs_status_t uct_ep_get_short(uct_ep_h ep, void *buffer, unsigned length, uint64_t remote_addr, uct_rkey_t rkey);
functions.description: RMA GET using short protocol: read remote data into buffer.
requirements: ep must be valid.
length <= iface_attr.cap.get.max_short.
buffer must be writable for length bytes.
remote_addr/rkey valid for remote read.

functions.name: uct_ep_get_bcopy
functions.signature: UCT_INLINE_API ucs_status_t uct_ep_get_bcopy(uct_ep_h ep, uct_unpack_callback_t unpack_cb, void *arg, size_t length, uint64_t remote_addr, uct_rkey_t rkey, uct_completion_t *comp);
functions.description: RMA GET using bcopy: transport fetches data and user unpack_cb copies from a provided buffer; may be async.
requirements: ep must be valid.
length <= iface_attr.cap.get.max_bcopy.
unpack_cb must be non-NULL to copy out received data.
remote_addr/rkey valid.
comp may be NULL or valid completion handle.

functions.name: uct_ep_get_zcopy
functions.signature: UCT_INLINE_API ucs_status_t uct_ep_get_zcopy(uct_ep_h ep, const uct_iov_t *iov, size_t iovcnt, uint64_t remote_addr, uct_rkey_t rkey, uct_completion_t *comp);
functions.description: RMA GET zero-copy: scatter remote data to registered iov; may complete asynchronously.
requirements: ep must be valid.
iov/iovcnt valid; iovcnt <= iface_attr.cap.get.max_iov; total length within min_zcopy..max_zcopy.
Local buffers registered and meet alignment requirements.
remote_addr/rkey valid for read.
If UCS_INPROGRESS, don't touch buffers until comp completes.

functions.name: uct_ep_am_short
functions.signature: UCT_INLINE_API ucs_status_t uct_ep_am_short(uct_ep_h ep, uint8_t id, uint64_t header, const void *payload, unsigned length);
functions.description: Active Message short send with small payload and 64-bit header; copies payload into transport buffer.
requirements: ep must be valid.
id in 0..UCT_AM_ID_MAX-1 and handler set on receiver.
length <= iface_attr.cap.am.max_short minus header requirements (total max).
Transport must support UCT_IFACE_FLAG_AM_SHORT.

functions.name: uct_ep_am_short_iov
functions.signature: UCT_INLINE_API ucs_status_t uct_ep_am_short_iov(uct_ep_h ep, uint8_t id, const uct_iov_t *iov, size_t iovcnt);
functions.description: Active Message short send with iov payload; gathers data to contiguous buffer; synchronous complete on success.
requirements: ep must be valid.
id valid.
iov/iovcnt valid; iovcnt <= iface_attr.cap.am.max_iov; total size <= iface_attr.cap.am.max_short.
Transport must support AM short iov.

functions.name: uct_ep_am_bcopy
functions.signature: UCT_INLINE_API ssize_t uct_ep_am_bcopy(uct_ep_h ep, uint8_t id, uct_pack_callback_t pack_cb, void *arg, unsigned flags);
functions.description: Active Message bcopy send: user pack_cb fills payload; returns packed length or error.
requirements: ep must be valid.
id valid.
pack_cb must be non-NULL.
flags are uct_msg_flags (e.g., UCT_SEND_FLAG_SIGNALED/PEER_CHECK) as supported.
Transport must support UCT_IFACE_FLAG_AM_BCOPY.

functions.name: uct_ep_am_zcopy
functions.signature: UCT_INLINE_API ucs_status_t uct_ep_am_zcopy(uct_ep_h ep, uint8_t id, const void *header, unsigned header_length, const uct_iov_t *iov, size_t iovcnt, unsigned flags, uct_completion_t *comp);
functions.description: Active Message zero-copy send with header and registered iov payload; may complete asynchronously.
requirements: ep must be valid.
id valid.
header/header_length must be within iface_attr.cap.am.max_hdr.
iov/iovcnt valid; iovcnt <= iface_attr.cap.am.max_iov; total size within min_zcopy..max_zcopy.
flags per uct_msg_flags; may require interface event capabilities for signaling semantics.
If UCS_INPROGRESS, iov buffers must remain valid until comp completes.
Transport must support UCT_IFACE_FLAG_AM_ZCOPY.

functions.name: uct_ep_atomic_cswap64
functions.signature: UCT_INLINE_API ucs_status_t uct_ep_atomic_cswap64(uct_ep_h ep, uint64_t compare, uint64_t swap, uint64_t remote_addr, uct_rkey_t rkey, uint64_t *result, uct_completion_t *comp);
functions.description: 64-bit atomic compare-and-swap on remote memory, returning old value; may be async.
requirements: ep must be valid and support 64-bit atomics with appropriate domain flags (CPU/DEVICE).
remote_addr/rkey must reference remote atomic-capable memory.
result must be non-NULL.
comp may be NULL or valid completion handle.

functions.name: uct_ep_atomic_cswap32
functions.signature: UCT_INLINE_API ucs_status_t uct_ep_atomic_cswap32(uct_ep_h ep, uint32_t compare, uint32_t swap, uint64_t remote_addr, uct_rkey_t rkey, uint32_t *result, uct_completion_t *comp);
functions.description: 32-bit atomic compare-and-swap on remote memory, returning old value; may be async.
requirements: ep must be valid and support 32-bit atomics.
remote_addr/rkey valid for atomic.
result non-NULL.
comp optional.

functions.name: uct_ep_atomic32_post
functions.signature: UCT_INLINE_API ucs_status_t uct_ep_atomic32_post(uct_ep_h ep, uct_atomic_op_t opcode, uint32_t value, uint64_t remote_addr, uct_rkey_t rkey);

import random
import string
from typing import List

# Data type: generic string
# Used by stubs as C strings for:
# - env_prefix (NULL or string prefix)
# - filenames for optional config include
# - UCP/UCT names, titles
# - configuration keys and values
# - interface memory allocation name
# Goal: produce a bytes buffer that fuzzer framework will use both as FUZZ_PARAM_STR
#       and FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME initial corpus. We should include multiple NUL-terminated
#       strings and also plausible filenames in one buffer since the harness may slice.
# Strategy:
# - Build a small container with several concatenated C strings separated by newlines.
# - Include: env prefixes (alnum and with underscore), valid-looking keys like UCX_*,
#   UCT_* options, values (numbers, booleans, sizes with units), titles, names with spaces,
#   and file path candidates. Keep under 4KB.
# - Ensure ASCII and some UTF-8 to exercise parsing.
# - Terminate each logical string with a newline; many fuzzers will extract substrings.
# - Also include NULs between some entries to exercise c_str boundary cases safely.

SIZE_LIMIT = 4096

UCX_KEYS = [
    "UCX_LOG_LEVEL", "UCX_NET_DEVICES", "UCX_TLS", "UCX_WORKER_MAX_EP",
    "UCX_IB_GPU_DIRECT_RDMA", "UCX_MAX_EAGER_LANES", "UCX_MAX_RNDV_LANES"
]

UCT_KEYS = [
    "RC_TX_QUEUE_LEN", "RC_TX_CQ_LEN", "UD_TX_QUEUE_LEN", "SOCKCM_PRIV_DATA_LEN",
    "AM_MAX_SHORT", "AM_MAX_BCOPY", "AM_MAX_ZCOPY"
]

SIZE_VALUES = [
    "0", "1", "16", "64", "128", "256", "512", "1024", "4k", "64k", "1m", "32m"
]

BOOL_VALUES = ["y", "n", "yes", "no", "true", "false", "on", "off"]

TLS_VALUES = [
    "all", "tcp", "rc,ud", "sm,self", "rc_x,ud_x,tcp", "posix,sysv,knem"
]

DEV_VALUES = [
    "all", "mlx5_0:1", "mlx5_1:1,mlx5_2:1", "eth0", "lo", "enp1s0"
]

UTF8_SNIPPETS = [
    "名称", "тест", "prüf", "δοκιμή", "測試", "テスト", "테스트"
]

PATH_DIRS = ["/etc", "/tmp", "/var/tmp", ".", "./conf", "C:/temp", ".."]

EXTS = [".conf", ".cfg", ".ini", ".txt", ""]


def _rand_choice(rng: random.Random, items: List[str]) -> str:
    return rng.choice(items)


def _rand_env_prefix(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # env_prefix is used as <prefix>_UCX_. Keep it alnum and underscores.
    base = ''.join(rng.choice(string.ascii_uppercase + string.digits) for _ in range(rng.randint(2, 8)))
    # Occasionally include underscore or mixed case
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        base += '_' + ''.join(rng.choice(string.ascii_uppercase) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 3)))
    return base


def _rand_keyval(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Construct either UCX_ or UCT_ style key=value
    if rng.random() < 0.6:
        key = _rand_choice(rng, UCX_KEYS)
        if "TLS" in key:
            val = _rand_choice(rng, TLS_VALUES)
        elif "DEV" in key:
            val = _rand_choice(rng, DEV_VALUES)
        elif "LOG_LEVEL" in key:
            val = _rand_choice(rng, ["fatal", "error", "warn", "info", "debug", "trace"])
        else:
            val = _rand_choice(rng, SIZE_VALUES + BOOL_VALUES)
        return f"{key}={val}"
    else:
        key = _rand_choice(rng, UCT_KEYS)
        if "LEN" in key or "MAX" in key:
            val = _rand_choice(rng, SIZE_VALUES)
        else:
            val = _rand_choice(rng, BOOL_VALUES)
        # UCT options often namespaced by TL, but keep simple
        return f"{key}={val}"


def _rand_title(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    words = [
        _rand_choice(rng, ["Config", "UCP", "UCT", "Worker", "Context", "Listener", "Endpoint"]),
        _rand_choice(rng, ["Dump", "Settings", "Info", "Parameters", "Attrs"]),
    ]
    if rng.random() < 0.4:
        words.append(_rand_choice(rng, UTF8_SNIPPETS))
    return ' '.join(words)


def _rand_name(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    base = _rand_choice(rng, ["worker", "context", "listener", "ep", "iface"]) + "-" + str(rng.randint(0, 9999))
    if rng.random() < 0.3:
        base += "-" + _rand_choice(rng, UTF8_SNIPPETS)
    return base


def _rand_filename(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    dirp = _rand_choice(rng, PATH_DIRS)
    fname = ''.join(rng.choice(string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "-_" ) for _ in range(rng.randint(3, 10)))
    if rng.random() < 0.4:
        # YAML-like or cfg
        ext = _rand_choice(rng, EXTS)
    else:
        ext = _rand_choice(rng, EXTS)
    path_sep = '/' if not dirp.endswith(':') else '\\'
    # Handle current/relative
    if dirp in (".", ".."):
        full = f"{dirp}/{fname}{ext}"
    else:
        full = f"{dirp}{path_sep}{fname}{ext}"
    return full


def _make_block(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    parts: List[bytes] = []

    # 1) Env prefixes
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 3)):
        parts.append((_rand_env_prefix(rng) + "\n").encode('utf-8'))

    # 2) Config keys/values
    for _ in range(rng.randint(3, 8)):
        parts.append((_rand_keyval(rng) + "\n").encode('utf-8'))

    # 3) Titles and names
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 3)):
        parts.append((_rand_title(rng) + "\n").encode('utf-8'))
    for _ in range(rng.randint(2, 5)):
        parts.append((_rand_name(rng) + "\n").encode('utf-8'))

    # 4) Filenames
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 4)):
        parts.append((_rand_filename(rng) + "\n").encode('utf-8'))

    # 5) Include some raw NUL-separated tokens to act as clean C strings when sliced
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 3)):
        token = _rand_choice(rng, [
            _rand_env_prefix(rng),
            _rand_title(rng),
            _rand_name(rng),
            _rand_filename(rng),
            _rand_keyval(rng)
        ])
        parts.append(token.encode('utf-8') + b"\x00")

    blob = b''.join(parts)
    # Trim to size limit
    if len(blob) > SIZE_LIMIT:
        blob = blob[:SIZE_LIMIT]
    return blob


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    # Optionally produce multiple blocks to diversify content in one buffer
    blocks = [_make_block(rng) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 3))]
    out = b"\n".join(blocks)
    # Ensure non-empty and within limit
    if not out:
        out = b"UCX_LOG_LEVEL=info\n"
    return out[:SIZE_LIMIT]

import os

# Data type: filename with arbitrary binary data
# Fuzzer stub under test: ucp_config_read(env_prefix, filename, &config)
# The harness may pass our buffer as a file path (via FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME) and the
# file contents are arbitrary bytes that the library may parse as a config file.
# It may also pass an env prefix string (via FUZZ_PARAM_STR). Our single bytes
# buffer should therefore be a plausible UCX config text so that ucp_config_read
# can successfully parse interesting keys. UCX config format accepts lines of:
#   KEY=value\n
# Strategy:
# - Produce a small textual config with multiple lines covering common option
#   shapes: integers, booleans, strings, sizes with units, lists, unknown keys,
#   comments, whitespace, and boundary-like values. Keep <= 4096 bytes.
# - Randomize option names from a pool of known UCX/UCT keys and add some noise.
# - Include both valid and ignorable lines to exercise different code paths while
#   remaining overall valid.

_VALID_KEYS = [
    # Common UCX global keys (examples)
    "LOG_LEVEL", "BM_REDUCE_SYNC", "USE_MT_MUTEX", "MEMTYPE_CACHE",
    "ASYNC_MODE", "TLS", "MAX_EAGER_RNDV_RAILS", "RNDV_THRESH",
    "RNDV_SCHEME", "ZCOPY_THRESH", "BCOPY_THRESH", "SHM_MD", "MM_BACKING",
    "NET_DEVICES", "SELF_DEVICES", "SHM_DEVICES", "ACC_DEVICES",
    "ALLOC_PRIO", "BCOPY_BW", "MAX_SHORT", "MAX_BCOPY", "MIN_ZCOPY",
    # UCT per-transport style keys
    "TCP_TX_SEG_SIZE", "TCP_RX_SEG_SIZE", "TCP_RX_COPY_THRESH",
    "RC_VERBS_TM_ENABLE", "RC_MLX5_TM_ENABLE", "UD_TIMEOUT",
    "IB_TX_QUEUE_LEN", "IB_RX_QUEUE_LEN", "IB_GPU_DIRECT_RDMA",
]

_VALID_VALUES_INT = ["0", "1", "2", "4", "8", "16", "32", "64", "128", "256", "1024"]
_VALID_VALUES_BOOL = ["y", "n", "yes", "no", "true", "false", "on", "off", "Y", "N"]
_VALID_VALUES_STR = [
    "posix", "sysv", "malloc", "thp", "huge", "cuda", "rocm",
    "self", "tcp", "rc", "ud", "sm", "mm", "shm",
]
_VALID_VALUES_UNITS = [
    "64", "128", "256", "512", "1k", "2k", "4k", "8k",
    "16k", "32k", "64k", "128k", "256k", "512k",
    "1m", "2m", "4m", "8m",
]

_RNDV_SCHEMES = ["put_zcopy", "get_zcopy", "auto"]
_ASYNC_MODES = ["thread", "signal", "poll"]
_LOG_LEVELS = ["error", "warn", "info", "debug", "trace"]

_UNKNOWN_KEYS = [
    "FOO_BAR", "EXTRA_OPTION", "UNKNOWN_SWITCH", "CUSTOM_PATH",
]

def _rand_choice(rng, arr):
    return arr[rng.randrange(len(arr))]

def _make_line_kv(rng):
    key = _rand_choice(rng, _VALID_KEYS)
    # Select a value style based on key hints
    if "LOG_LEVEL" in key:
        val = _rand_choice(rng, _LOG_LEVELS)
    elif key in ("ASYNC_MODE",):
        val = _rand_choice(rng, _ASYNC_MODES)
    elif "TLS" in key:
        # Comma-separated list of transports
        tls = ["tcp", "rc", "ud", "sm", "mm", "self"]
        rng.shuffle(tls)
        cnt = rng.randint(1, min(3, len(tls)))
        val = ",".join(tls[:cnt])
    elif any(s in key for s in ["THRESH", "SIZE", "LEN", "BW", "SHORT", "BCOPY", "ZCOPY"]):
        val = _rand_choice(rng, _VALID_VALUES_UNITS)
    elif any(s in key for s in ["ENABLE", "CACHE"]):
        val = _rand_choice(rng, _VALID_VALUES_BOOL)
    elif any(s in key for s in ["RNDV_SCHEME"]):
        val = _rand_choice(rng, _RNDV_SCHEMES)
    elif any(s in key for s in ["DEVICES", "MD", "BACKING"]):
        # device lists
        devs = ["all", "any", "none", "mlx5_0:1", "eth0", "lo"] + _VALID_VALUES_STR
        rng.shuffle(devs)
        cnt = rng.randint(1, 3)
        val = ",".join(devs[:cnt])
    else:
        # generic values
        picker = rng.random()
        if picker < 0.33:
            val = _rand_choice(rng, _VALID_VALUES_INT)
        elif picker < 0.66:
            val = _rand_choice(rng, _VALID_VALUES_BOOL)
        else:
            val = _rand_choice(rng, _VALID_VALUES_STR)
    # Random whitespace around '=' and values
    ws_left = " " * rng.randint(0, 2)
    ws_right = " " * rng.randint(0, 2)
    return f"{key}{ws_left}={ws_right}{val}"

def _make_unknown_line(rng):
    key = _rand_choice(rng, _UNKNOWN_KEYS)
    val = _rand_choice(rng, _VALID_VALUES_INT + _VALID_VALUES_BOOL + _VALID_VALUES_STR + _VALID_VALUES_UNITS)
    return f"{key}={val}"

def _make_comment(rng):
    prefixes = ["#", "//"]
    msg = [
        " Sample config", " optional", " ignored", " note", " test",
        " boundary", " path", " perf", " debug",
    ]
    return f"{_rand_choice(rng, prefixes)}{_rand_choice(rng, msg)}"

def _make_blank(rng):
    return "" if rng.random() < 0.5 else " " * rng.randint(1, 3)

def _make_special_cases(rng):
    # Include a few known interesting lines targeting UCX parsing
    lines = []
    lines.append("LOG_LEVEL=\"%s\"" % _rand_choice(rng, _LOG_LEVELS))  # quoted
    lines.append("ASYNC_MODE=%s" % _rand_choice(rng, _ASYNC_MODES))
    lines.append("RNDV_THRESH=%s" % _rand_choice(rng, ["auto", "inf", "1k", "0"]))
    lines.append("RNDV_SCHEME=%s" % _rand_choice(rng, _RNDV_SCHEMES))
    lines.append("MEMTYPE_CACHE=%s" % _rand_choice(rng, _VALID_VALUES_BOOL))
    # Whitespace-heavy
    lines.append("  ZCOPY_THRESH   =   %s" % _rand_choice(rng, _VALID_VALUES_UNITS))
    # List with spaces
    lines.append("TLS = tcp, rc, self")
    return lines

def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    lines = []

    # Header comment and version hint
    lines.append(_make_comment(rng))
    lines.extend(_make_special_cases(rng))

    # Generate a random number of valid kv lines
    kv_count = rng.randint(8, 20)
    used = set()
    for _ in range(kv_count):
        line = _make_line_kv(rng)
        # avoid duplicate keys occasionally
        key = line.split("=", 1)[0].strip()
        if key in used and rng.random() < 0.6:
            continue
        used.add(key)
        lines.append(line)
        # Interleave comments/blanks
        if rng.random() < 0.3:
            lines.append(_make_comment(rng))
        if rng.random() < 0.2:
            lines.append(_make_blank(rng))

    # Add some unknown/ignored keys
    unk_count = rng.randint(2, 6)
    for _ in range(unk_count):
        lines.append(_make_unknown_line(rng))

    # Trailing comments and blanks
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 3)):
        lines.append(_make_comment(rng))
        lines.append(_make_blank(rng))

    content = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

    # Enforce size limit
    data = content.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore")[:4096]
    return data

import os
import random
from typing import List

# Generator for arbitrary binary blob inputs tailored to UCX stubs using FUZZ_PARAM_STR/FILENAME.
# We focus on producing valid, interesting payloads for:
# - ucp_am_send_nb: AM payloads and ids/flags are fuzzed by harness; we provide payload bytes.
# - ucp_stream_send_nb: stream payload bytes.
# - ucp_tag_send_nb / ucp_tag_send_sync_nb: tagged send payload bytes.
# - ucp_put_nbi / ucp_put_nb: local readable buffer bytes; length > 0 useful.
# - uct_md_mem_query / uct_md_mem_reg / uct_md_detect_memory_type: require non-NULL address and length > 0.
# Therefore, we bias towards non-empty buffers of varying sizes, alignments, and contents.

MAX_SIZE = 4096

# Predefined interesting patterns to exercise different code paths (zero, ascii, repeated, random, aligned sizes)
INTERESTING_SIZES = [1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 15, 16, 31, 32, 63, 64, 127, 128, 255, 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4095, 4096]

ASCII_SENTENCES = [
    b"",  # rare, but some stubs bail on empty; keep very low probability
    b"hello ucx", b"A" * 1, b"B" * 8, b"C" * 64,
    b"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog",
    b"0123456789abcdef" * 4,
]

# A mix of payload constructors

def _rand_bytes(rng: random.Random, n: int) -> bytes:
    return bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(n))


def _pattern_repeat(pattern: bytes, n: int) -> bytes:
    if not pattern:
        return b""
    reps, rem = divmod(n, len(pattern))
    return pattern * reps + pattern[:rem]


def _make_payloads(rng: random.Random) -> List[bytes]:
    payloads: List[bytes] = []

    # 1) Small ASCII sentences and repeats
    for s in ASCII_SENTENCES:
        # Expand to a variety of lengths to test short/medium/long paths
        for target in [len(s), 8, 32, 128]:
            if target == 0:
                payloads.append(b"")
            else:
                payloads.append(_pattern_repeat(s if s else b"x", target))

    # 2) Boundary/interesting sizes with random content
    for sz in INTERESTING_SIZES:
        if sz <= MAX_SIZE:
            payloads.append(_rand_bytes(rng, sz))

    # 3) Structured-like headers (useful for AM header/data handling even if opaque)
    # Compose a simple TLV-ish buffer: [len32][type8][flags8][reserved16][payload]
    for sz in [0, 4, 16, 64, 256]:
        base = bytearray()
        payload = _rand_bytes(rng, sz)
        total_len = 4 + 1 + 1 + 2 + len(payload)
        base += total_len.to_bytes(4, 'little')
        base += bytes([rng.randrange(0, 4)])  # type
        base += bytes([rng.randrange(0, 0x10)])  # flags
        base += b"\x00\x00"  # reserved
        base += payload
        payloads.append(bytes(base))

    # 4) Repeated single-byte patterns
    for bval in [0x00, 0xFF, 0x7F, 0x80, 0x55, 0xAA]:
        payloads.append(bytes([bval]) * 128)

    # 5) Increasing bytes pattern
    inc = bytes([i & 0xFF for i in range(256)])
    payloads.append(_pattern_repeat(inc, 512))

    # Ensure we include some mid-size random buffers
    for _ in range(5):
        sz = rng.randrange(17, min(1500, MAX_SIZE))
        payloads.append(_rand_bytes(rng, sz))

    # De-duplicate while preserving order and enforce size limit
    seen = set()
    unique: List[bytes] = []
    for p in payloads:
        if len(p) > MAX_SIZE:
            p = p[:MAX_SIZE]
        key = (len(p), hash(p))
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            unique.append(p)
    return unique


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    # Choose a strategy: prefer non-empty buffers since many stubs require len > 0
    payloads = _make_payloads(rng)

    # Weighted choice favoring non-empty buffers but occasionally empty
    non_empty = [p for p in payloads if len(p) > 0]
    empty = [p for p in payloads if len(p) == 0]

    choices = []
    weights = []
    # Heavily weight non-empty
    for p in non_empty:
        choices.append(p)
        # Prefer boundary sizes more by weighting via proximity to interesting sizes
        w = 1
        if len(p) in INTERESTING_SIZES:
            w = 4
        elif len(p) < 64:
            w = 2
        weights.append(w)
    # Small chance of empty
    for p in empty:
        choices.append(p)
        weights.append(1)

    # Select
    sel = rng.choices(choices, weights=weights, k=1)[0]

    # Final guard against excessive size
    if len(sel) > MAX_SIZE:
        sel = sel[:MAX_SIZE]

    return bytes(sel)
